local HotBase = script:WaitForChild(`HotBase`)
local MetalBase = script:WaitForChild(`MetalBase`)
local FabricBase = script:WaitForChild(`FabricBase`)
local DefaultBase = script:WaitForChild(`DefaultBase`)
local GlassBase = script:WaitForChild(`GlassBase`)

local Module = {
	Materials = {
		[`{Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal.Name}`] = MetalBase,
		[`{Enum.Material.DiamondPlate.Name}`] = MetalBase,
		[`{Enum.Material.Metal.Name}`] = MetalBase,
		[`{Enum.Material.Glass.Name}`] = GlassBase,
		[`{Enum.Material.ForceField.Name}`] = GlassBase,
		[`{Enum.Material.Fabric.Name}`] = FabricBase,
		[`{Enum.Material.Carpet.Name}`] = FabricBase,
		[`{Enum.Material.CrackedLava.Name}`] = HotBase,
		Default = DefaultBase
	}
}

function Module.GetRandomByMaterial(Material: string): Sound?
	local Base = Module.Materials[`{Material}`] or Module.Materials.Default
	return Base:GetChildren()[math.random(1, #Base:GetChildren())]
end

function Module.GetRandomIdByMaterial(Material: string): string
	local Sound = Module.GetRandomByMaterial(Material)
	return Sound and string.gsub(`{Sound.SoundId}`, "%D", "") or `0`
end

function Module.SetMaterialBase(Material: string, Base: Folder)
	for _, Child in Base:GetChildren() do
		assert(Child:IsA(`Sound`), `[{script}] Sounds ClassName expected, got: {Child.ClassName}, Base: {Base}`)
	end
	Module.Materials[`{Material}`] = Base
end

return Module

local DEFAULT_AUDIO_VOLUME = 1
local DEFAULT_RAYCAST_LENGHT = vector.create(0, 1024, 0)
local DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTE_MATERIAL = `RainMaterial`
local DEFAULT_SPLASH_ATTACHMENTS = 50
local DEFAULT_MIN_DISTANCE = 16
local DEFAULT_RAIN_RATE = 250
local DEFAULT_MOVE_MODE = Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged

local DEFAULT_MATERIALS_VOLUME = {
	Default = 1,
	[Enum.Material.Fabric.Name] = 3,
	--[Enum.Material.Glass.Name] = 1,
	--[Enum.Material.ForceField.Name] = 1,
	[Enum.Material.Metal.Name] = 2.5,
	[Enum.Material.DiamondPlate.Name] = 2.5,
	[Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal.Name] = 2.5,
}

local Rain = {}

export type Rain = typeof(Rain)

local function GetCircleGrid(Radius: number, CellSize: number)
	local Grid = {}
	local Inserted = 0
	local radiusSquared = Radius * Radius

	local steps = math.floor(Radius / CellSize)

	for i = -steps, steps do
		local x = i * CellSize
		local xSquared = x * x
		if xSquared <= radiusSquared then
			local maxZ = math.sqrt(radiusSquared - xSquared)
			local zSteps = math.floor(maxZ / CellSize)

			for j = -zSteps, zSteps do
				local z = j * CellSize
				Inserted += 1
				Grid[Inserted] = Vector3.new(x, 0, z)
			end
		end
	end

	return Grid
end

local function GetFocusDistance(Camera: Camera): (number)
	local Adjust = 5
	local FocusTan = math.tan(math.rad(math.max(2, Camera.FieldOfView) / 2))
	local FocusDistance = 1 / FocusTan
	local ScaledDistance = FocusDistance * Adjust
	return ScaledDistance
end

local function GetGridCellPosition(
	Position: vector,
	GridCellSize: vector,
	Shape: Enum.PartType
): (vector, boolean)

	--debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)

	local IsGridBlockShape = Shape == Enum.PartType.Block

	local FinalPosition = IsGridBlockShape and vector.create(
		math.ceil(Position.X / GridCellSize.X) * GridCellSize.X,
		math.ceil(Position.Y / GridCellSize.Y) * GridCellSize.Y,
		math.ceil(Position.Z / GridCellSize.Z) * GridCellSize.Z
	) or vector.create(
		math.ceil(Position.X / GridCellSize.X) * GridCellSize.X,
		math.ceil(Position.Y / GridCellSize.X) * GridCellSize.X,
		math.ceil(Position.Z / GridCellSize.X) * GridCellSize.X
	)

	if FinalPosition ~= FinalPosition then
		FinalPosition = IsGridBlockShape and Position * GridCellSize or Position * GridCellSize.x
		print(Position, GridCellSize)
	end

	return FinalPosition, IsGridBlockShape--, debug.profileend()
end

do type([[ Rain ]])
	
	do
		Rain._Private = {
			Enabled = nil :: boolean,
			Trove = nil :: Utils.Trove,
			MaterialSoundsEnabled = nil :: boolean,
			RainSplasesPool = nil :: Utils.Pool,
			WorldParticles = nil :: DynamicParticles.WorldParticles,
			AudioPlayers = nil :: { AudioPlayer },
			AudioEmitters = nil :: { AudioEmitter },
			AudioEmittersParts = nil :: { BasePart },
			ParticleEmitterParts = nil :: { BasePart },
			CircleGrid = nil :: {vector},
			TotalCells = nil :: number,
			MinDistance = nil :: number,
			VectorCellSize = nil :: vector,
			LastGridPosition = nil :: vector,
			Camera = nil :: Camera,
			AudioVolumeAdjusted = nil :: number,
			AudioVolume = nil :: number,
			AudioVolumeMaterials = nil :: {[string]: number},
		}

		Rain.Properties = nil :: DynamicParticles.WorldParticlesProperties
		Rain.RainSounds = RainSounds
		Rain.__index = Rain
	end
	
	function Rain.Step(self: Rain, Dt: number)
		
		debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)
		
		local Private = self._Private
		
		local RAIN_MIN_DISTANCE = Private.MinDistance
		local RAIN_AUDIO_MIN_DISTANCE = RAIN_MIN_DISTANCE + 15
		local RAIN_RAY_LENGHT = DEFAULT_RAYCAST_LENGHT
		local VECTOR_GRID_CELL_SIZE = Private.VectorCellSize
		
		local FakeCamera = Private.Camera
		local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local CurrentCameraCFrame = CurrentCamera.CFrame
		local CurrentCameraPosition = CurrentCameraCFrame.Position
		local FocusDistance = GetFocusDistance(CurrentCamera)

		local CameraPosition: vector do

			debug.profilebegin(`{script}_CameraPosition`)

			local RaycastData = {
				Position = CurrentCameraPosition,
				Direction = CurrentCameraCFrame.LookVector * FocusDistance
			}

			local RaycastResult = Raycaster.Raycast(RaycastData) --Raycaster.Raycast(RaycastData)

			if RaycastResult then
				CameraPosition = vector.create(RaycastResult.Position.x, CurrentCameraPosition.Y, RaycastResult.Position.z)
			else
				CameraPosition = CurrentCameraPosition + RaycastData.Direction -- CurrentCameraCFrame.LookVector * FocusDistance
			end
			
			local rX, rY, rZ = CurrentCameraCFrame:ToOrientation()
			local limX = math.clamp(rX, 0, math.rad(90))
			FakeCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(CurrentCameraPosition) * CFrame.Angles(limX, rY, rZ)

			debug.profileend()
		end

		local NewGridPosition = GetGridCellPosition(CameraPosition, VECTOR_GRID_CELL_SIZE, Enum.PartType.Block)
		
		if NewGridPosition ~= Private.LastGridPosition then
			Private.LastGridPosition = NewGridPosition
			local EmitterPositions = {}
			local BulkCFrames = {}
			local BulkEmitters = {}
			local Inserted = 0

			local function CalculateResults(BlockcastResults: {[any]: RaycastResult})
				debug.profilebegin(`{script}_Update`)

				local MaterialByDistance = true
				
				for I, BlockcastResult in BlockcastResults do
					local EmitterPosition = EmitterPositions[I]
					
					if BlockcastResult then
						
						local BlockcastResultPosition = vector.create(EmitterPosition.x, BlockcastResult.Position.Y, EmitterPosition.z) :: vector-- RaycastResult.Position :: vector
						local ParticleEmitterPositionOffset = math.max(EmitterPosition.y - BlockcastResultPosition.y, RAIN_MIN_DISTANCE)
						local ParticleEmitterPosition = BlockcastResultPosition + vector.create(0, ParticleEmitterPositionOffset, 0)
						local AudioEmitterPositionOffset = math.min(ParticleEmitterPosition.y - BlockcastResultPosition.y, RAIN_AUDIO_MIN_DISTANCE)
						local AudioEmitterPosition = ParticleEmitterPosition + vector.create(0, -AudioEmitterPositionOffset, 0)
						
						MaterialByDistance = AudioEmitterPositionOffset < RAIN_AUDIO_MIN_DISTANCE
						BulkCFrames[I] = CFrame.new(ParticleEmitterPosition)
						BulkCFrames[Inserted + I] = CFrame.new(AudioEmitterPosition)
					else
						local NoBlockcastCFrame = CFrame.new(CurrentCameraPosition + vector.create(0, RAIN_MIN_DISTANCE, 0))
						BulkCFrames[I] = NoBlockcastCFrame
						BulkCFrames[Inserted + I] = NoBlockcastCFrame
					end

					BulkEmitters[Inserted + I] = Private.AudioEmittersParts[I]

					local AudioPlayer = Private.AudioPlayers[I]
					if AudioPlayer then
						AudioPlayer:SetAttribute(DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTE_MATERIAL, Private.MaterialSoundsEnabled and MaterialByDistance and BlockcastResult and BlockcastResult.Material.Name or nil)
					end
					
					--print(MaterialByDistance)
				end
				
				for I, Emitter in BulkEmitters do
					Emitter.CFrame = BulkCFrames[I]
				end
				
				--workspace:BulkMoveTo(BulkEmitters, BulkCFrames, DEFAULT_MOVE_MODE)

				debug.profileend()
			end

			local BulkBlockcastData = {} :: Raycaster.BulkBlockcast
			BulkBlockcastData.Positions = {}
			BulkBlockcastData.Directions = -RAIN_RAY_LENGHT
			--BulkBlockcastData.Sizes = VECTOR_GRID_CELL_SIZE
			BulkBlockcastData.Parallel = true
			BulkBlockcastData.ParallelAsync = CalculateResults

			for EmitterOffset, RainEmitter in Private.ParticleEmitterParts do
				Inserted += 1

				local EmitterPosition = CameraPosition + EmitterOffset
				local BlockcastPosition = EmitterPosition + RAIN_RAY_LENGHT / 2
				
				--if BlockcastPosition ~= BlockcastPosition then
				--	print(BlockcastPosition, EmitterPosition, RAIN_RAY_LENGHT / 2)
				--end
				
				EmitterPositions[Inserted] = EmitterPosition
				BulkEmitters[Inserted] = RainEmitter
				BulkBlockcastData.Positions[Inserted] = BlockcastPosition --CFrame.new(BlockcastPosition)
			end
			Raycaster.BulkRaycast(BulkBlockcastData)
			
			--Raycaster.BulkBlockcast(BulkBlockcastData) Blockcast is very unstable, can return math.huge or NaN
		end

		debug.profileend()
		
		do
			
			local WorldParticles = Private.WorldParticles
			if WorldParticles.Properties.Emitters then
				WorldParticles:Step(Dt)
			else
				warn(`[{script}] Emitters not found`)
			end
		end
		
	end
	
	do type([[ SET ]])
		
		function Rain.SetEnabled(self: Rain, Enabled: boolean?): Rain
			local Private = self._Private
			local AudioPlayers = Private.AudioPlayers
			Private.Enabled = Enabled == true
			Private.WorldParticles.Properties.Emitting = Private.Enabled
			
			for _, AudioPlayer in AudioPlayers do
				if Private.Enabled then
					AudioPlayer:Play()
				else
					AudioPlayer:Stop()
				end
			end
			
			return self
		end
		
		
		function Rain.SetRate(self: Rain, Rate: number)
			self._Private.WorldParticles:SetRate(Rate)
			return self
		end
		
		function Rain.SetEmitters(self: Rain, Emitters: BasePart | {BasePart})
			self._Private.WorldParticles.Properties.Emitters = Emitters
			return self
		end
		
		function Rain.SetMinDistance(self: Rain, Distance: number)
			self._Private.MinDistance = Distance
		end
		
		function Rain.SetMaterialVolume(self: Rain, Material: string, Volume: number?, ForceUpdate: boolean?)
			local Private = self._Private
			Private.AudioVolumeMaterials[Material] = tonumber(Volume)
			return ForceUpdate and self:SetVolume(Private.AudioVolume) or self
		end
		
		function Rain.SetVolume(self: Rain, Volume: number)
			
			local Private = self._Private
			local AdjustedVolume = Volume * 10 / Private.TotalCells
			Private.AudioVolumeAdjusted = AdjustedVolume
			Private.AudioVolume = Volume
			
			for _, AudioPlayer in Private.AudioPlayers do
				AudioPlayer.Volume = Volume * (DEFAULT_MATERIALS_VOLUME[AudioPlayer:GetAttribute(DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTE_MATERIAL)] or DEFAULT_MATERIALS_VOLUME.Default)
			end
			
			return self
		end
		
		function Rain.SetAudioMaterialsEnabled(self: Rain, Enabled: boolean?)
			self._Private.MaterialSoundsEnabled = Enabled == true
		end

		--function Rain.SetAudioVolumeAdjusted(self: Rain, Volume: number): Rain
		--	self._AudioPlayer:SetValue("Volume", Volume)
		--	return self
		--end
		
		--function Rain.SetAudioCurve(self: Rain, Curve: {{[number]: number}}): Rain
		--	self._AudioEmitter:SetDistanceAttenuation(Curve)
		--	return self
		--end
		
		--[[W.I.P]]
		function Rain.SetSplashTexture(self: Rain, Id: number | string): Rain
			
			return self
		end
		
		--function Rain.SetCFrame(self: Rain, CFrame: CFrame): Rain
		--	self._EmitBasePart.CFrame = CFrame
		--	return self
		--end
	end
	
	do type([[ CLEAR ]])
		function Rain.ClearSplahes(self: Rain)

		end
		
		function Rain.Destroy(self: Rain)
			self._Private.Trove:Destroy()
			setmetatable(self, nil)
		end
	end
	
	table.freeze(Rain)
end

return table.deepFreeze({
	New = function(Radius: number, CellSize: number): Rain
		
		local RainAttachment = script:WaitForChild(`RainAttachment`)
		
		local self = setmetatable({ _Private = {} }, Rain) :: Rain
		local Private = self._Private
		local SubTrove = Trove:Extend(`{self}`)
		local Storage = SubTrove:Add(Instance.new(`Folder`))
		Storage.Name = `{script}_Storage`
		Storage.Parent = workspace.Terrain
		local VectorCellSize = vector.create(CellSize, CellSize, CellSize)
		
		local RainSplasesPool = BasicPool.New() do
			for I = 1, DEFAULT_SPLASH_ATTACHMENTS do
				local Clone = SubTrove:Add(RainAttachment:Clone()) --script:WaitForChild(`RainAttachment`):Clone()
				Clone.Parent = Storage
				RainSplasesPool:Set(Clone)
			end
		end

		local WorldParticles = SubTrove:Add(DynamicParticles.NewWorldParticles()) do
			local Camera = Instance.new(`Camera`)
			Camera.FieldOfView = 120
			Camera.Parent = Storage
			
			local WorldParticleIndexes = DynamicParticles.GetWorldParticleIndexes()

			local Properties = WorldParticles.Properties do
				local CollisionBindableEvent = SubTrove:Add(Instance.new(`BindableEvent`))
				Properties.Lifetime = vector.one * 3
				Properties.ParticlesMax = math.huge
				Properties.Speed = vector.one * 75
				Properties.Drag = 0
				Properties.WindEnabled = true
				Properties.WindAffectsDrag = false
				Properties.WindUseGlobal = true
				Properties.DistanceFPS = 360
				Properties.CollisionEnabled = true
				Properties.CollisionDestroying = true
				Properties.CullingEnabled = true
				Properties.CullingDestroying = false
				Properties.LookAtVelocity = true
				Properties.Particles = script:WaitForChild(`Raindrop`)
				Properties.EmitDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
				Properties.LockedToPart = true
				Properties.ParticleChooseMode = Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Random
				Properties.EmitterChooseMode = Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Random
				Properties.BindableCollision = CollisionBindableEvent
				Properties.RotationZ = vector.create(90, 1, 55)
				Properties.GridCellSize = Properties.Particles.Size
				Properties.CollisionMaxParts = 1
				Properties.UsePoolIfPossible = true
				Properties.EmitSize = VectorCellSize
				Properties.CollisionRaycastValidation = true
				Properties.CollisionUseOverlapParams = false
				--Properties.Camera = Camera
				---Properties.CullingDestroying = true
				WorldParticles:SetRate(DEFAULT_RAIN_RATE)

				if Properties.BindableCollision then
					SubTrove:Add(CollisionBindableEvent.Event:Connect(function(RaycastResult: RaycastResult)
						local RainAttachment = RainSplasesPool:Next()
						
						--print(`hit`, RaycastResult)
						if RainAttachment then
							RainAttachment.CFrame = CFrame.new(RaycastResult.Position)
							RainAttachment.Shockwave1:Emit(1)
						end
					end))
				end

				do
					self.Properties = Properties
					self._Private = Private
					Private.Enabled = DEFAULT_ENABLED
					Private.Trove = SubTrove
					Private.WorldParticles = WorldParticles
					Private.Camera = Camera
				end
			end
		end

		do -- Rain test
			local ParticleEmitterPart = script:WaitForChild(`ParticleEmitterPV`)
			local AudioEmitterPart = script:WaitForChild(`AudioEmitterPV`)
			local AudioEmitter = script:WaitForChild(`AudioEmitter`)
			local AudioPlayer = script:WaitForChild(`AudioPlayer`)

			local AudioPlayers = {} Private.AudioPlayers = AudioPlayers
			local AudioEmitters = {} Private.AudioEmitters = AudioEmitters
			local AudioEmittersParts = {} Private.AudioEmittersParts = AudioEmittersParts
			local ParticleEmitterParts = {} Private.ParticleEmitterParts = ParticleEmitterParts

			do
				local CircleGrid = GetCircleGrid(Radius, CellSize)
				local TotalCells = #CircleGrid

				for I, Position in CircleGrid do
					local ParticleEmitterPart = SubTrove:Add(ParticleEmitterPart:Clone())
					ParticleEmitterParts[Position] = ParticleEmitterPart
					--ParticleEmitterPart.Size = VectorCellSize
					ParticleEmitterPart.Parent = Storage

					local AudioEmitterPart = SubTrove:Add(AudioEmitterPart:Clone())
					AudioEmittersParts[I] = AudioEmitterPart
					--AudioEmitterPart.Size = VectorCellSize
					AudioEmitterPart.Parent = Storage

					local AudioPlayer = Harmonica.NewAudioInput(Instance.fromExisting(AudioPlayer))

					local function GetMaterialRain()
						
						local Material = AudioPlayer:GetAttribute(DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTE_MATERIAL)
						local MaterialVolume = DEFAULT_MATERIALS_VOLUME[Material] or DEFAULT_MATERIALS_VOLUME.Default
						AudioPlayer.PlaybackSpeed = RNG:NextNumber(0.5, 1.5)
						AudioPlayer.Asset = `rbxassetid://{RainSounds.GetRandomIdByMaterial(Material)}`
						AudioPlayer.Volume = Private.AudioVolumeAdjusted * MaterialVolume
							
						if Private.Enabled then
							AudioPlayer:Play()
						end
					end

					AudioPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal(DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTE_MATERIAL):Connect(GetMaterialRain)
					AudioPlayer.Ended:Connect(GetMaterialRain)
					AudioPlayer.Parent = AudioEmitterPart
					--GetMaterialRain()

					local AudioEmitter = Harmonica.NewAudioOutput(Instance.fromExisting(AudioEmitter))
					AudioEmitter.Parent = AudioEmitterPart
					AudioEmitter:SetInput(AudioPlayer)

					AudioPlayers[I] = AudioPlayer
					AudioEmitters[I] = AudioEmitter
				end
				
				Private.TotalCells = TotalCells
				Private.VectorCellSize = VectorCellSize
				Private.AudioVolume = 0
				Private.AudioVolumeAdjusted = 0
				Private.AudioVolumeMaterials = {}
				self:SetMinDistance(DEFAULT_MIN_DISTANCE)
				self:SetEmitters(ParticleEmitterParts)
				
				for Material, Volume in DEFAULT_MATERIALS_VOLUME do
					self:SetMaterialVolume(Material, Volume)
				end
				self:SetVolume(DEFAULT_AUDIO_VOLUME)
			end
		end

		self:SetEnabled(DEFAULT_ENABLED)

		return self
	end	
})--.New()

local Source = script:WaitForChild(`Source`).Value
local SetParallel = require(Source:WaitForChild(`SetParallel`))
local ModuleScript_Calculations = Source:WaitForChild(`WorldParticlesCalculations`)
local Calculations = require(ModuleScript_Calculations)

SetParallel.CreateWorker(script:GetActor(), function(self)
	
	assert(type(Calculations) == `table`, `[{script}] table expected, got: {typeof(Calculations)}`)
	for Topic, Function in Calculations do
		if type(Function) == `function` then					
			self:BindToMessage(true, Topic, Function)
		else
			warn(`[{script}] Module: {ModuleScript_Calculations}, Index: {Topic}, function expected, got: {typeof(Function)}`)
		end
	end
end)

local function magnitude(...: number)
	local Numbers = {...}
	local Sum = 0

	for I = 1, #Numbers do
		Sum += Numbers[I]^2 --* Numbers[I]
	end

	return math.sqrt(Sum)
end

local function assert(Value: any, Reason: string, Out: (Message: string)-> ()?)
	if not Value then
		(Out or error)(Reason, 2)
	end
end

local function Lerp(Start, Finish, Alpha)
	return Start + Alpha * (Finish - Start)
end

local function StealMetamethod(thunk: () -> ()): (...any) -> ...any -- https://devforum.roblox.com/t/%E2%96%A8-how-2-make-roblox-engineers-cry-illegal-luau-optimizations-and-how-to-use-them/4128934

	xpcall(thunk, function()
		stolen = debug.info(2, "f")
	end)

	return stolen :: (...any) -> ...any
end

	local function GetNextEmitter(ForceCFrame: CFrame?)--: ((BasePart | PVInstance | Attachment)?, vector, CFrame, boolean)
		local ChooseMode = Properties.EmitterChooseMode
		local EmitSize, EmitCFrame, Emitter
		local IsBasePart = false
		local Next = 0
	
		if ChooseMode == ParticleFlipbookModeRandom then
			if EmittersInfo.TotalObjects >= 1 then
				Next = NextInteger(RNG, 1, EmittersInfo.TotalObjects)
			end
		elseif ChooseMode == ParticleFlipbookModePingPong then

			if EmittersInfo.TotalObjects >= 1 then

				Next = math.clamp(EmittersInfo.Next + EmittersInfo.PingPongDirection, 1, EmittersInfo.TotalObjects)

				if Next <= 1 then
					EmittersInfo.PingPongDirection = 1
				elseif Next >= EmittersInfo.TotalObjects then
					EmittersInfo.PingPongDirection = -1
				end
			end
		else
			if ChooseMode and ChooseMode ~= ParticleFlipbookModeLoop then
				warn(`[{script}] ChooseMode {ChooseMode} is not supported`)
			end
			
			Next = math.max(1, (EmittersInfo.Next + 1) % (EmittersInfo.TotalObjects + 1))
		end
		
		EmittersInfo.Next = Next
		
		local ObjectData = EmittersInfo.Objects[Next]
		
		if ObjectData then
			local Object = ObjectData[EmittersIndexes.Object] :: CFramable
			Emitter = Object
			
			if ObjectData[EmittersIndexes.IsBasePart] then
				EmitSize = Properties.EmitSize or Object.Size
				EmitCFrame = ForceCFrame or Properties.EmitCFrame or Object.CFrame
				IsBasePart = true
			else
				EmitSize = Properties.EmitSize or vector.zero
				EmitCFrame = ForceCFrame or Properties.EmitCFrame or Object.CFrame
			end
		else
			EmitSize = Properties.EmitSize or vector.zero
			EmitCFrame = Properties.EmitCFrame or CFrameIdentity
		end
		
		return ObjectData, Emitter, EmitSize / 2, EmitCFrame, IsBasePart
	end
	
	local function GetNextParticle(): ({["1"]: CFramable, ["2"]: boolean})?
		local ChooseMode = Properties.ParticleChooseMode
		local Objects = ParticlesInfo.Objects
		
		if not ChooseMode or ChooseMode == ParticleFlipbookModeLoop then
			local Next = math.max(1, (ParticlesInfo.Next + 1) % (ParticlesInfo.TotalObjects + 1))
			ParticlesInfo.Next = Next
			return Objects[Next]
		elseif ChooseMode == ParticleFlipbookModeRandom then
			if ParticlesInfo.TotalObjects >= 1 then
				return Objects[NextInteger(RNG, 1, ParticlesInfo.TotalObjects)]
			end
		elseif ChooseMode == ParticleFlipbookModePingPong then
			
			if ParticlesInfo.TotalObjects >= 1 then
				
				local Next = math.clamp(ParticlesInfo.Next + ParticlesInfo.PingPongDirection, 1, ParticlesInfo.TotalObjects)
				ParticlesInfo.Next = Next
				
				if Next <= 1 then
					ParticlesInfo.PingPongDirection = 1
				elseif Next >= ParticlesInfo.TotalObjects then
					ParticlesInfo.PingPongDirection = -1
				end
				
				return Objects[Next]
			end
		else

		end
	end

			elseif EmittersType == `table` then

	function Module.WorldParticlesEmitAtCFrame(
		EmitCFrame: CFrame?, 
		Amount: number
	)

		local MaxParticles = math.ceil(Properties.MaxParticles / ActorsCount)
		local MaxParticlesAmountToSpawn = math.ceil((MaxParticles - (ParticlesInfo.TotalParticles)))
		local Lifetime = Properties.Lifetime
		if MaxParticlesAmountToSpawn < 1 
			or Lifetime.y <= 0 
			or Lifetime.y ~= Lifetime.y
		then
			return
		end
			
		task.synchronize()

		debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)
		
		local CullingParticleRadius = Properties.CullingParticleRadius
		local IsParticleBasePart
		local ParticlePV
		
		if ParticlesInfo.TotalObjects > 0 then
			local EmitParticlePacked = GetNextParticle()
			ParticlePV = EmitParticlePacked[1]
			IsParticleBasePart = EmitParticlePacked[2]
			
			if Properties.CullingParticleRadiusUseSize and IsParticleBasePart then
				local Size = ParticlePV.Size
				CullingParticleRadius = math.max(Size.X, Size.Y, Size.Z)
			end
		end
		
		local BasePartsInserted = 0
		local BasePartsCFrames = {} :: {[number]: CFrame}
		local BaseParts = {} :: {[number]: BasePart}
		local PVCFrames = {} :: {[CFramable]: CFrame}

		for I = 1, math.min(MaxParticlesAmountToSpawn, tonumber(Amount) or 1) do

			ParticlesInfo.TotalParticles += 1
			
			local EmitterData, Emitter, EmitSize, EmitCFrame, EmitIsBasePart = GetNextEmitter(EmitCFrame)
			local EmitCFrameOffset = CFrame.new(
				NextNumber(RNG, -EmitSize.X, EmitSize.X),
				NextNumber(RNG, -EmitSize.Y, EmitSize.Y),
				NextNumber(RNG, -EmitSize.Z, EmitSize.Z)
			)
			
			local FinalEmitCFrame = EmitCFrame * EmitCFrameOffset

			if Properties.CullingDestroying and IsCullable(FinalEmitCFrame.Position, CullingParticleRadius) then
				continue
			end

			debug.profilebegin(`{script}_Emit`)

			local Unique
			repeat
				Unique = NextInteger(RNG, 1, 2^31)
			until not ParticlesInfo.Particles[Unique] --Private.Particles.Values[Unique]
			
			do
				local ObjectPool = ParticlesInfo.IsPoolPossible
				local Data = {}
				ParticlesInfo.Particles[Unique] = Data
				
				do
					local Spread = Properties.Spread / 2
					local SpreadX = NextNumber(RNG, -Spread.X, Spread.X)
					local SpreadY = NextNumber(RNG, -Spread.Y, Spread.Y)
					local SpreadZ = NextNumber(RNG, -Spread.Z, Spread.Z)

					if magnitude(SpreadX, SpreadY, SpreadZ) > 0 then -- Optimization?
						RandomEmitCFrameOffset *= CFrame.Angles( -- Only for spread
							math.rad(SpreadX), 
							math.rad(SpreadY), 
							math.rad(SpreadZ)
						)
					end
				end
				
				do
					local RotationX = Properties.RotationX
					local RotationY = Properties.RotationY
					local RotationZ = Properties.RotationZ
					
					Data[ParticleIndexes.Rotation] = vector.create(
						math.rad(NextNumber(RNG, -RotationX.x, RotationX.x)),
						math.rad(NextNumber(RNG, -RotationY.x, RotationY.x)),
						math.rad(NextNumber(RNG, -RotationZ.x, RotationY.x))
					)
					
					Data[ParticleIndexes.RotationSpeed] = vector.create(
						math.rad(NextNumber(RNG, -RotationX.y, RotationX.z)), 
						math.rad(NextNumber(RNG, -RotationY.y, RotationY.z)), 
						math.rad(NextNumber(RNG, -RotationZ.y, RotationZ.z))
					)
				end
				
				if ParticlePV then
					
					if ObjectPool then
						--print(ObjectPool, getmetatable(ObjectPool))
						local Getted = ObjectPool:Get() or Instance.fromExisting(ParticlePV)
						ObjectPool:SetRegister(Getted, true)
						ParticlePV = Getted
					else
						ParticlePV = Instance.fromExisting(ParticlePV)
					end
					
					if IsParticleBasePart then
						BasePartsInserted += 1
						BasePartsCFrames[BasePartsInserted] = FinalEmitCFrame
						BaseParts[BasePartsInserted] = ParticlePV
					else
						PVCFrames[ParticlePV] = FinalEmitCFrame
					end
				end
				
				Data[ParticleIndexes.EmitterData] = EmitterData
				Data[ParticleIndexes.IsBasePart] = IsParticleBasePart
				Data[ParticleIndexes.Particle] = ParticlePV
				--Data[ParticleIndexes.MaxParticleRadius] = MaxParticleRadius
				Data[ParticleIndexes.Random] = NextInteger(RNG, 1, 1024)
				Data[ParticleIndexes.Age] = 0
				Data[ParticleIndexes.MaxAge] = NextNumber(RNG, Lifetime.x, Lifetime.y)
				Data[ParticleIndexes.Delta] = 0
				Data[ParticleIndexes.EmitCFrame] = EmitCFrame
				Data[ParticleIndexes.Pool] = ObjectPool
				Data[ParticleIndexes.CFrame] = EmitCFrameOffset --CFrameIdentity --RandomEmitCFrame
				
				do
					local EmitDirection: vector = Properties.EmitDirectionVector or VectorNormals[Properties.EmitDirection]
					local VelocityOnEmit = (Properties.UseBasePartVelocityOnEmit 
						and (EmitIsBasePart and RawInstanceIndex(Emitter, `AssemblyLinearVelocity`))
						or vector.zero)
						+ Properties.VelocityOnEmit
						+ EmitDirection * NextNumber(RNG, Properties.Speed.x, Properties.Speed.y)
					
					Data[ParticleIndexes.Velocity] = VelocityOnEmit
				end
			end

			debug.profileend()
		end
		
		do -- Fix visual bug
			local ParentString = `Parent`
			local CFrameString = `CFrame`
			BulkMoveTo(workspace, BaseParts, BasePartsCFrames, ParticlesInfo.BulkMoveMode)
			for _, BasePart in BaseParts do
				RawInstanceNewIndex(BasePart, ParentString, ParticlesInfo.Storage)
				--BasePart.Parent = ParticlesInfo.Storage
			end
			
			for PV, PVCFrame in PVCFrames do
				RawInstanceNewIndex(PV, ParentString, ParticlesInfo.Storage)
				RawInstanceNewIndex(PV, CFrameString, PVCFrame)
				--PV.Parent = ParticlesInfo.Storage
				--PV.CFrame = PVCFrame
			end
		end
		
		debug.profileend()

		task.desynchronize()
	end

	function Module.WorldParticlesStep(
		DeltaTime: number, 
		DisabledByAmount: number
	)
		--print(`hi`)
		
		do -- Updating step values
			Frame %= 36000
			Frame += 1
			
			Camera = Properties.Camera or RawInstanceIndex(workspace, `CurrentCamera`) --workspace.CurrentCamera
			CameraCFrame = RawInstanceIndex(Camera, `CFrame`) --Camera.CFrame
			CameraPosition = CameraCFrame.Position :: vector
			CameraPlanes = FrustumCulling.getFrustum(Camera, tonumber(Properties.CullingDistance) or 1000)
		end -- do end

		if Properties.Emitting and (Properties.EmitOnUnfocusedWindow or (not Properties.EmitOnUnfocusedWindow and IsWindowFocused)) and not DisabledByAmount then
			DeltaLife += --[[math.min(]]DeltaTime--, 1) -- Limiting delta to 1 to prevent any possible overflow
			RateSmoothAlpha = math.min(RateSmoothAlpha + DeltaLife, Properties.RateSmooth)
			local LerpedRate = Lerp(
				RateOld, 
				RateNew, 
				RateSmoothAlpha == Properties.RateSmooth and 1 or RateSmoothAlpha / Properties.RateSmooth
			)
			
			local Rate = 1 / (LerpedRate / ActorsCount)
			local AmountToEmit = DeltaLife // Rate--, (Properties.ParticlesMax / ActorsCount))
			DeltaLife -= Rate * AmountToEmit
			
			Module.WorldParticlesEmitAtCFrame(nil, AmountToEmit) --self:Emit(AmountToEmit)
		end
	
		local FunctionName = debug.info(1, `n`)
		debug.profilebegin(`{FunctionName}_Desync`)
		
		local TotalBasePartParticles = 0
		local ParticlesBaseParts = {} :: {BasePart}
		local ParticlesBasePartsCFrames = {} :: {CFrame}
		local ParticlesPVCFrames = {} :: {[CFramable]: CFrame}
		local CollisionGrid = {}
		
		local CullingParticleRadius = Properties.CullingParticleRadius
		
		local WindVelocity do 
			local GlobalWind = Properties.WindUseGlobal and RawInstanceIndex(workspace, `GlobalWind`) or Properties.WindVelocity or vector.zero --or workspace.GlobalWind
			local WindCalculated = GlobalWind--Properties.WindEnabled and (GlobalWind * (Properties.WindAffectsDrag and Properties.Drag or 1)) or vector.zero
			WindVelocity = WindCalculated
		end -- do end
		
		do
			for _, Data in EmittersInfo.Objects do
				
				local Emitter = Data[EmittersIndexes.Object] :: CFramable
				local NewCFrame = RawInstanceIndex(Emitter, `CFrame`) --Emitter.CFrame
				local OldCFrame = Data[EmittersIndexes.OldCFrame] :: CFrame
				if Properties.LockedToPart and NewCFrame ~= OldCFrame then
					Data[EmittersIndexes.CFrameDifference] = (NewCFrame:Inverse() * OldCFrame):Inverse()
				else
					Data[EmittersIndexes.CFrameDifference] = CFrameIdentity
				end
				
				Data[EmittersIndexes.OldCFrame] = NewCFrame
			end
		end -- do end
		
		for I, Data in ParticlesInfo.Particles do
			
			if not Data[ParticleIndexes.Velocity] then continue end -- Data is not ready
			
			Data[ParticleIndexes.Delta] += DeltaTime
			
			local EmitterData = Data[ParticleIndexes.EmitterData]
			local EmitCFrame: CFrame do
				EmitCFrame = Data[ParticleIndexes.EmitCFrame]
				if Properties.LockedToPart then
					EmitCFrame *= EmitterData[EmittersIndexes.CFrameDifference] :: CFrame
					Data[ParticleIndexes.EmitCFrame] = EmitCFrame
				end
			end
			
			local RealParticleCFrame: CFrame = EmitCFrame --[[* Data[ParticleIndexes.EmitCFrameOffset]] * Data[ParticleIndexes.CFrame] --ParticleCFrame
			local RealParticlePosition: vector = RealParticleCFrame.Position
			
			if (Frame + Data[ParticleIndexes.Random]) % math.ceil(vector.magnitude(CameraPosition - RealParticlePosition) / (Properties.DistanceFPS or 30)) == 0 then

				if Data[ParticleIndexes.Age] >= Data[ParticleIndexes.MaxAge] then
					Despawn(I)
					continue
				end
				
				local DeltaTime = Data[ParticleIndexes.Delta] :: number
				local DeltaDrag = 1 / (1 + (DeltaTime * Properties.Drag)) :: number -- MUST be here
				local ParticlePV = Data[ParticleIndexes.Particle] :: CFramable
				local ParticleIsBasePart = Data[ParticleIndexes.IsBasePart] :: boolean
				local Velocity = Data[ParticleIndexes.Velocity] :: vector
				local VelocityToAdd = vector.zero
				
				Data[ParticleIndexes.Delta] = 0
				Data[ParticleIndexes.Age] = math.min(Data[ParticleIndexes.Age] + DeltaTime, Data[ParticleIndexes.MaxAge])
				
				do -- Default velocity properties
					
					VelocityToAdd += Properties.WindRelativeToEmit and WindVelocity or VectorToObjectSpace(RealParticleCFrame, WindVelocity)
					VelocityToAdd += Properties.Acceleration
					
					do -- Drag
						VelocityToAdd *= DeltaDrag
						Velocity *= DeltaDrag
					end
				end
				
				local FinalVelocity = Velocity + (VelocityToAdd * DeltaTime)
				local FinalDeltaVelocity = FinalVelocity * DeltaTime
				local FinalRealPosition = RealParticlePosition + FinalDeltaVelocity
				
				do -- Collision
					if Properties.CollisionEnabled then

						debug.profilebegin(`{FunctionName}_Collision`)
						
						local RaycastResult
						local CollidedParts: {BasePart} = EmptyTable
						
						if Properties.CollisionRaycastValidation then
							RaycastResult = Raycast(workspace, RealParticlePosition, FinalDeltaVelocity, RaycastParams)
							
							if RaycastResult then
								FinalRealPosition = RaycastResult.Position
								CollidedParts = {RaycastResult.Instance}
							end
						end
						
						
						if Properties.CollisionUseOverlapParams then
							local GridPosition, IsGridBlockShape = WorldParticlesData.GetGridCellPosition(FinalRealPosition, Properties.GridCellSize, Properties.GridShape)
							if CollisionGrid[GridPosition] then
								CollidedParts = CollisionGrid[GridPosition]
							else
								CollidedParts = IsGridBlockShape 
									and GetPartBoundsInBox(workspace, CFrame.new(GridPosition), Properties.GridCellSize, OverlapParams) 
									or GetPartBoundsInRadius(workspace, GridPosition, Properties.GridCellSize.x, OverlapParams)

								CollisionGrid[GridPosition] = CollidedParts
							end
						end
						
						--print(#CollidedParts)
						if #CollidedParts > 0 then
							
							local BindableCollision = Properties.BindableCollision
							if BindableCollision then
								--print(CollidedParts[1])
								Fire(BindableCollision, {
									Instance = CollidedParts[1],
									Normal = RaycastResult and RaycastResult.Normal,
									Material = RaycastResult and RaycastResult.Material or CollidedParts[1].Material,
									Position = FinalRealPosition
								})
							end
							
							if Properties.CollisionDestroying then
								Despawn(I)
							else
								
								if WorldParticlesData.UseSphericalCollision then
									
									for _, CollidedPart: BasePart in CollidedParts do	
										
										local Inside, Push, Normal
										if WorldParticlesData.UseDynamicSphericalCollision then
											Inside, Push, Normal = CollisionsAlgorithms.DynamicSphereIntersection(CollidedPart, RealParticlePosition, vector.magnitude(Properties.CollisionSize))
										else
											Inside, Push, Normal = ((IsA(CollidedPart, `Part`) and CollisionShapes[RawInstanceIndex(CollidedPart, `Shape`)]) or CollisionShapes.Default)(RawInstanceIndex(CollidedPart, `CFrame`), RawInstanceIndex(CollidedPart, `Size`), RealParticlePosition, vector.magnitude(Properties.CollisionSize))
										end
										
										if Inside then
											local VelocityAtPosition = GetVelocityAtPosition(CollidedPart, FinalRealPosition) :: vector
											local relativeVelocity = VelocityAtPosition - FinalVelocity 
											
											-- Calculate velocity components along normal and tangent directions
											local velocityAlongNormal = vector.dot(relativeVelocity, Normal)
											local tangentVelocity  = relativeVelocity - Normal * velocityAlongNormal
											
											-- Calculate friction force
											local frictionMagnitude = -Properties.CollisionFriction * vector.magnitude(tangentVelocity)
											local NormalizedTangentVelocity = vector.normalize(-tangentVelocity)
											local frictionForce = (NormalizedTangentVelocity == NormalizedTangentVelocity and NormalizedTangentVelocity or vector.zero) * frictionMagnitude
											
											-- Calculate bounce vector
											local bounceVector = Normal * (velocityAlongNormal * (Properties.CollisionBounce + 1))
											
											-- Calculate final velocity
											local CollisionFinalVelocity = bounceVector + (frictionForce * DeltaTime)
											
											-- Apply final velocity
											FinalVelocity += CollisionFinalVelocity
											FinalRealPosition = Push
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end

						debug.profileend()
					end
				end
				
				local FinalRealCFrame: CFrame do
					local Rotation = Data[ParticleIndexes.Rotation] :: vector
					local RotationSpeed = Data[ParticleIndexes.RotationSpeed] :: vector
					Rotation += RotationSpeed * DeltaTime
					Data[ParticleIndexes.Rotation] = Rotation
					
					local LookAtPosition = Properties.LookAt or 
						(Properties.LookAtCamera and CameraPosition) or 
						(Properties.LookAtVelocity and FinalRealPosition + FinalDeltaVelocity)
					
					if LookAtPosition then
						FinalRealCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(FinalRealPosition, LookAtPosition)
					else
						FinalRealCFrame = CFrame.new(FinalRealPosition)
					end
					
					if vector.magnitude(Rotation) ~= 0 then
						FinalRealCFrame *= CFrame.Angles(Rotation.x, Rotation.y, Rotation.z)
					end
				end
				
				local PositionDifference = FinalRealPosition - RealParticlePosition
				Data[ParticleIndexes.Velocity] = FinalVelocity
				Data[ParticleIndexes.CFrame] += PositionDifference
				
				if Properties.CullingParticleRadiusUseSize and ParticleIsBasePart then
					local Size = ParticlePV.Size :: vector
					CullingParticleRadius = math.max(Size.x, Size.y, Size.z)
				end
				
				if IsCullable(FinalRealPosition, ParticleIsBasePart and CullingParticleRadius) then

					if Properties.CullingDestroying then
						Despawn(I)
						continue
					elseif not ParticlePV or RawInstanceIndex(ParticlePV, `CFrame`) == ParticlesInfo.GarbageCFrame then -- Optimization
						continue
					else
						FinalRealCFrame = ParticlesInfo.GarbageCFrame
					end
				end
				
				if ParticlePV then
					if ParticleIsBasePart then
						TotalBasePartParticles += 1
						ParticlesBasePartsCFrames[TotalBasePartParticles] = FinalRealCFrame
						ParticlesBaseParts[TotalBasePartParticles] = ParticlePV
					else
						ParticlesPVCFrames[ParticlePV] = FinalRealCFrame
					end
				end
			end
		end
		
		debug.profileend()
		task.synchronize()
	
		debug.profilebegin(`{FunctionName}_Sync`) do
			
			do -- Update particles CFrame Move particles
				BulkMoveTo(workspace, ParticlesBaseParts, ParticlesBasePartsCFrames, ParticlesInfo.BulkMoveMode)
				
				for ParticlePV, FianlCFrame in ParticlesPVCFrames do
					RawInstanceNewIndex(ParticlePV, `CFrame`, FianlCFrame)
				end
			end
			
			debug.profilebegin(`{FunctionName}_Despawning`)
			
			for I, Data in ParticlesInfo.Despawned do
				local ParticlePV = Data[ParticleIndexes.Particle]
				local Pool = Data[ParticleIndexes.Pool] :: BasicPool.Pool
				if getmetatable(Pool) then
					RawInstanceNewIndex(ParticlePV, `Parent`, nil)
					Pool:SetRegister(ParticlePV)
					Pool:Set(ParticlePV)
				else
					Destroy(ParticlePV)
				end
				
				ParticlesInfo.Despawned[I] = nil
			end
			
			for Pool in ParticlesInfo.Pools do
				if ParticlesInfo.IsPoolPossible ~= Pool and getmetatable(Pool) then
					
					local RawPool = Pool:GetPool()
					for ParticlePV in RawPool do
						Destroy(ParticlePV)
						RawPool[ParticlePV] = nil
					end
					
					local TotalRegistred = Pool:GetTotalRegistred()
					if TotalRegistred <= 0 then
						ParticlesInfo.Pools[Pool] = nil
						setmetatable(Pool, nil)
						--print(`Destroy`)
					end
				end
			end
			
			debug.profileend()
		end
		debug.profileend()
	
		return ParticlesInfo.TotalParticles > 0
	end -- End of function
end -- do end

return table.freeze(Module)

local FrustumCulling = {} do
	type Plane = {P: vector, M: number}

	function FrustumCulling.getFrustum(Camera: Camera, renderDistance)
		local CameraCFrame = Camera.CFrame
		local CameraPosition = CameraCFrame.Position :: vector

		local cameraHorizontalLimit = math.rad(Camera.MaxAxisFieldOfView) / 2
		local cameraverticalLimit = math.rad(Camera.FieldOfView) / 2

		-- Near Plane
		local nearPlaneCF = CameraCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, Camera.NearPlaneZ)
		local nearNormal = -nearPlaneCF.LookVector :: vector
		local p1 = {P = nearNormal, M = vector.dot(-nearNormal, nearPlaneCF.Position :: vector)}

		-- Far Plane
		local farPlaneCF = CameraCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -renderDistance)
		local farNormal = farPlaneCF.LookVector :: vector
		local p2 = {P = farNormal, M = vector.dot(-farNormal, farPlaneCF.Position :: vector)}

		-- Right Plane
		local rightPlaneCF = CameraCFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, cameraHorizontalLimit, 0)
		local rightNormal = -rightPlaneCF.RightVector :: vector
		local p3 = {P = rightNormal, M = vector.dot(-rightNormal, CameraPosition)}

		-- Left Plane
		local leftPlaneCF = CameraCFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, -cameraHorizontalLimit, 0)
		local leftNormal = leftPlaneCF.RightVector :: vector
		local p4 = {P = leftNormal, M = vector.dot(-leftNormal, CameraPosition)}

		-- Low Plane
		local lowPlaneCF = CameraCFrame * CFrame.Angles(-cameraverticalLimit, 0, 0)
		local lowNormal = -lowPlaneCF.UpVector :: vector
		local p5 = {P = lowNormal, M = vector.dot(-lowNormal, CameraPosition)}

		-- Up Plane
		local upPlaneCF = CameraCFrame * CFrame.Angles(cameraverticalLimit, 0, 0)
		local upNormal = upPlaneCF.UpVector :: vector
		local p6 = {P = upNormal, M = vector.dot(-upNormal, CameraPosition)}

		return {p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6} :: {Plane}
	end

	function FrustumCulling.findInFrustumPoint(
		planes: {Plane}, 
		objectPos: vector
	)
		for _, plane in planes do
			if vector.dot(objectPos, plane.P) + plane.M >= 0 then
				return false
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	function FrustumCulling.findInFrustumSphere(
		planes: {Plane}, 
		objectPos: vector, 
		size: number
	)
		for _, plane in planes do
			if vector.dot(objectPos, plane.P) + plane.M >= size then
				return false
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	function FrustumCulling.findInFrustumAABB(
		planes: {Plane}, 
		mins,
		maxs
	)
		local ret = "INSIDE"  -- Start assuming the box is inside unless proven otherwise.

		for i, plane in ipairs(planes) do
			local normal = plane.P
			local dist = plane.M

			local vmin = vector.create(
				(normal.X > 0) and mins.X or maxs.X,
				(normal.Y > 0) and mins.Y or maxs.Y,
				(normal.Z > 0) and mins.Z or maxs.Z
			)

			-- Determine the "most positive" vertex in relation to the plane normal
			local vmax = vector.create(
				(normal.X > 0) and maxs.X or mins.X,
				(normal.Y > 0) and maxs.Y or mins.Y,
				(normal.Z > 0) and maxs.Z or mins.Z
			)

			-- If the "most negative" vertex is outside the frustum, the entire box is outside
			if vector.dot(normal, vector.create(vmin.X, vmin.Y, vmin.Z)) + dist > 0 then
				return false
			end

			-- If the "most positive" vertex is inside, the box might intersect
			if vector.dot(normal, vector.create(vmax.X, vmax.Y, vmax.Z)) + dist >= 0 then
				ret = "Intersect"
			end
		end

		return ret  -- Could still be "INSIDE" if never updated to "Intersect"
	end

	function FrustumCulling.CalculateOBBVertices(
		cf: CFrame, 
		size: vector
	)
		local vertices = {}
		for i = -1, 1, 2 do
			for j = -1, 1, 2 do
				for k = -1, 1, 2 do
					local corner = vector.create(i * size.X / 2, j * size.Y / 2, k * size.Z / 2)
					local vertex = cf:PointToWorldSpace(corner)
					table.insert(vertices, vertex)
				end
			end
		end
		return vertices
	end

	function FrustumCulling.findInFrustumBox(
		planes: {Plane}, 
		Cf: CFrame, 
		size: vector
	)
		local vertices = FrustumCulling.CalculateOBBVertices(Cf, size)
		for _, plane in ipairs(planes) do
			local allOut = true
			for _, vertex in ipairs(vertices) do
				if vertex:Dot(plane["P"]) + plane["M"] <= 0 then
					allOut = false
					break
				end
			end
			if allOut then
				return false -- All vertices are outside this plane
			end
		end
		return true -- No plane could exclude all vertices
	end
	
	Module.FrustumCulling = FrustumCulling
end

local CollisionAlgoritms = {} do
	
	--[[
		Dunamic spherical collision algorithm that works with all BaseParts types.
		You can't use it in Parallel (right now): https://devforum.roblox.com/t/enable-ability-to-use-getclosestpointonsurface-in-parallel/4093116
	]]
	function CollisionAlgoritms.DynamicSphereIntersection(Collider: BasePart, ParticlePosition: vector, Radius: number): (boolean, vector, vector)
		local ClosestPoint = Collider:GetClosestPointOnSurface(ParticlePosition)
		local Relative = ClosestPoint - ParticlePosition
		local Distacne = vector.magnitude(Relative)
		if Radius > Distacne then
			return true, ClosestPoint, vector.normalize(Relative)
		end
	end

	--Optimized version Collision Detection between Ball and Particle.
	function CollisionAlgoritms.BallSphereIntersectionOptimized(cframe: CFrame, size: vector, point: vector, radius: number) : (boolean, vector, vector)
		local size : number = math.min(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * 0.5
		local pos : vector = cframe.Position
		local rel : vector = point - pos
		local dist : number= vector.magnitude(rel)

		if dist < size + radius then
			local normal : vector = vector.normalize(rel)
			local closestPoint = normal * (size + radius) + pos
			return true, closestPoint, normal
		else
			return nil
		end
	end

	--Optimized version Collision Detection between Cylinder and Particle.
	function CollisionAlgoritms.CylinderSphereIntersectionOptimized(cframe : CFrame, size : vector, point : vector, radius : number) : (boolean, vector, vector)
		local rel : vector = cframe:PointToObjectSpace(point)
		local sx : number, sy : number, sz : number = size.X + radius, size.Y + radius, size.Z + radius
		local rx : number, ry : number, rz : number = rel.X, rel.Y, rel.Z

		local cx : number = math.clamp(rx, -sx*0.5, sx*0.5)
		local distSquared : number = (ry*ry + rz*rz)
		local SizeYZmin : number = math.min(sy, sz)*0.5

		if not (cx == rx and (distSquared <= SizeYZmin * SizeYZmin)) then
			return nil
		else
			local dist : number = math.sqrt(distSquared)
			local closestPoint: vector = vector.create(rx, ry / dist * SizeYZmin, rz / dist * SizeYZmin)
			local relToClosestPoint : vector = closestPoint - vector.create(rx, ry, rz)

			local posX : number = rx - sx*0.5
			local negX : number = -rx - sx*0.5 

			local max = math.max(posX, negX)
			if -max > vector.magnitude(relToClosestPoint) then
				local normal : vector = vector.normalize(relToClosestPoint)
				return true, cframe*closestPoint, normal
			elseif max == posX then
				local closestPoint : vector = cframe*vector.create(sx*0.5, ry, rz)
				return true, closestPoint, cframe.XVector
			elseif max == negX then
				local closestPoint : vector = cframe*vector.create(-sx*0.5, ry, rz)
				return true, closestPoint, -cframe.XVector
			end
		end
	end

	--Optimized version Collision Detection between Box and Particle.
	function CollisionAlgoritms.BoxSphereIntersectionOptimized(cframe : CFrame, size : vector, point : vector, radius : number) : (boolean, vector, vector)
		local rel : vector = cframe:PointToObjectSpace(point)
		local sx : number, sy : number, sz : number = size.X + radius, size.Y + radius, size.Z + radius
		local rx : number, ry : number, rz : number = rel.X, rel.Y, rel.Z

		local cx : number = math.clamp(rx, -sx*0.5, sx*0.5)
		local cy : number = math.clamp(ry, -sy*0.5, sy*0.5)
		local cz : number = math.clamp(rz, -sz*0.5, sz*0.5)

		if not (cx == rx and cy == ry and cz == rz) then
			return nil
		end

		local posX : number = rx - sx*0.5 
		local posY : number = ry - sy*0.5 
		local posZ : number = rz - sz*0.5
		local negX : number = -rx - sx*0.5
		local negY : number = -ry - sy*0.5 
		local negZ : number = -rz - sz*0.5

		local max = math.max(posX, posY, posZ, negX, negY, negZ)
		if max == posX then
			local closestPoint : vector = cframe*vector.create(sx*0.5, ry, rz)
			return true, closestPoint, cframe.XVector
		elseif max == posY then
			local closestPoint : vector = cframe*vector.create(rx, sy*0.5, rz)
			return true, closestPoint, cframe.YVector
		elseif max == posZ then
			local closestPoint : vector = cframe*vector.create(rx, ry, sz*0.5)
			return true, closestPoint, cframe.ZVector
		elseif max == negX then
			local closestPoint : vector = cframe*vector.create(-sx*0.5, ry, rz)
			return true, closestPoint, -cframe.XVector
		elseif max == negY then
			local closestPoint : vector = cframe*vector.create(rx, -sy*0.5, rz)
			return true, closestPoint, -cframe.YVector
		elseif max == negZ then
			local closestPoint : vector = cframe*vector.create(rx, ry, -sz*0.5)
			return true, closestPoint, -cframe.ZVector
		end
	end
	
	Module.CollisionAlgoritms = CollisionAlgoritms
end

do
	
	function Module.GetGridCellPosition(
		Position: vector,
		GridCellSize: vector,

			math.round(Position.y / GridCellSize.x) * GridCellSize.x,

		)

				--print(Index, self, getmetatable(self))
				
				local Found = rawget(self, Index) or getmetatable(self)[Index]
				if Found then
					return Found
				else
					local Instance = rawget(self, `Instance`)
					local InstanceValue = Instance[Index]

					return type(InstanceValue) == `function` and function(self, ...)
						--print(Index, ...)
						return InstanceValue(Instance, ...)
					end or InstanceValue
				end
			end
			
			GlobalMeta.__newindex = function(self: GlobalMeta, Index: any, Value: any): ()
				self.Instance[Index] = Value
			end
			
			GlobalMeta._Trove = nil :: Utils.Trove

		end

			local Wire = Instance.new(`Wire`)

			Wire.SourceInstance = Source
			Wire.TargetInstance = Target
			Wire.Parent = Target
			--print(`New wire`, Wire, Wire.Name)

			local OutputMeta = getmetatable(Output)
			assert(OutputMeta == Metas.AudioOutput or OutputMeta == Metas.AudioEffect, `[{script}] AudioEffect or AudioOutput expected, got: {OutputMeta}`)
			
			local OutputTrove = Output._Trove
			local InputInstance = self.Instance
			local OutputInstance = Output.Instance
			local Wire = Connect(InputInstance, OutputInstance) -- It will get destroyed if Output if destroyed
			
			self.Outputs[Wire] = Output
			Output.Inputs[Wire] = self
			
			local DestroyConnect DestroyConnect = Wire.Destroying:Once(function()
				OutputTrove:Remove(DestroyConnect)
				
				self.Outputs[Wire] = nil
				Output.Inputs[Wire] = nil

function Module.Wrap<Function>(Function: Function): Function
	return function(...)
		local self = Function(...)
		self._Trove:Add(self.Instance.Destroying:Once(function()
			if getmetatable(self) then
				self:Destroy()
			end
		end))

		return self
	end
end

			assert(Position, `[{script}] Position with index: {I} not found`)
			assert(Direction, `[{script}] Direction with index: {I} not found`)
			assert(Size, `[{script}] Sizes with index: {I} not found`)
			--assert(Directions[I], `[{script}] Direction with index: {I}, not found`)
			RaycastResults[I] = workspace:Blockcast(Position, Size, Direction, RP) or false
		end
		
		debug.profileend()
		
		return RaycastResults, IsPositionsTable, IsDirectionsTable, IsRPsTable, IsSizesTable
	end

	function Module.BulkShapecast(BaseParts: {BasePart} | BasePart, Directions: {Vector3} | Vector3, RPs: {RaycastParams?} | RaycastParams): ({RaycastResult}, boolean, boolean, boolean, boolean)
		
		debug.profilebegin(debug.info(1, `n`))
		
		local RaycastResults = {}
		local IsInstance = typeof(BaseParts) == `Instance`
		local IsBasePartsTable = type(BaseParts) == `table` or assert(IsInstance and BaseParts:IsA(`BasePart`), `[{script}] BasePart expected, got {IsInstance and BaseParts.ClassName or typeof(BaseParts)}`) and nil
		local IsDirectionsTable = type(Directions) == `table` or assert(typeof(Directions) == `Vector3`, `[{script}] Direction Vector3 expected, got {typeof(Directions)}`) and nil
		local IsRPsTable = type(RPs) == `table` --or assert(typeof(Directions) == `RaycastParams`, `[{script}] RaycastParams expected, got {typeof(RPs)}`)

		for I, Value in (
				IsBasePartsTable and BaseParts
				or
				IsDirectionsTable and Directions
				or 
				IsRPsTable and RPs
				or 
				TableWithSingleElement
			)
		do

			local BasePart = IsBasePartsTable and BaseParts[I] or BaseParts :: BasePart
			local Direction = IsDirectionsTable and Directions[I] or Directions :: Vector3
			local RP = IsRPsTable and IsRPsTable[I] or RPs :: RaycastParams

			assert(BasePart, `[{script}] BasePart with index: {I} not found`)
			assert(Direction, `[{script}] Direction with index: {I} not found`)
			--assert(Directions[I], `[{script}] Direction with index: {I}, not found`)
			RaycastResults[I] = workspace:Shapecast(BasePart, Direction, RP) or false
		end
		
		debug.profileend()
		
		return RaycastResults, IsBasePartsTable, IsDirectionsTable, IsRPsTable
	end
end

return table.freeze(Module)

type VisualizeSettings = {
	--Color: Color3?,
	Transparency: number?,

}

do type([[ Debug ]])
	
	Debug.__index = Debug
	Debug.Lifetime = nil :: number
	Debug.CreateNew = nil :: boolean?
	Debug.Parent = nil :: Instance?
	Debug.SettingsTo = nil :: { ColorResult: Color3?, ColorNoResult: Color3? } & VisualizeSettings
	Debug.SettingsFrom = nil :: VisualizeSettings
	--Debug.SettingsResult = nil :: VisualizeSettings
	Debug.SettingsPath = nil :: VisualizeSettings
	--Debug.To = nil :: VisualizeSettings
	--Debug.From = nil :: VisualizeSettings
	--Debug.Result = nil :: VisualizeSettings
	Debug.Shape = nil :: any? -- Read-only
	Debug.Adornments = nil :: {[any]: Instance | AdornmentManager.Manager}
	Debug.DebounceIndex = nil :: string
	
	function Debug.Clear(self: Debug)
		local Adornments = self.Adornments
		for I, Adorment in Adornments do
			if getmetatable(Adorment) then
				Adorment:Destroy()
			end
			Adornments[I] = nil
		end
		
		--Debounce.Remove(self.DebounceIndex)
	end
	
	function Debug.Destroy(self: Debug)
		self:Clear()
		setmetatable(self, nil)
		tablem.deepFreeze(self)
	end
	
	table.freeze(Debug)
end

do type([[ LocalUtils ]])
	
	local COLOR_RESULT = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)
	local COLOR_NO_RESULT = Color3.new(1, 1, 0)
	local COLOR_FROM = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
	local COLOR_PATH = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local TRANSPARENCY = 0.5
	local VECTOR3_ONE = Vector3.one
	local SIZE_TO = VECTOR3_ONE / 3
	local SIZE_FROM = SIZE_TO
	local EmptyTable = table.freeze{}
	
	LocalUtils.Debug = Debug
	
	function LocalUtils.VisualizeDebug(
		DefaultData: Raycast | Shapecast | Blockcast | Spherecast, 
		RaycastResult: RaycastResult?, 
		Settings: {
			Shape: string | BasePart,
			Size: Vector3
		}?,
		
		Index: any?
	)
		--debug.profilebegin(`{script}_Debug`)
		
		Index = Index or 1
		local Debug = DefaultData.Debug
		local Direction = DefaultData.Direction
		local Position = DefaultData.Position :: Vector3 | CFrame -- CFrame from Blockcast
		local PositionType = typeof(Position) :: "CFrame" | "Vector3"
		
		if getmetatable(Debug) == LocalUtils.Debug then
			
			local SettingsTo = Debug.SettingsTo or EmptyTable :: typeof(Debug.SettingsTo) --VisualizeSettings
			local SettingsFrom = Debug.SettingsFrom or EmptyTable :: VisualizeSettings
			local SettingsPath = Debug.SettingsPath or EmptyTable :: VisualizeSettings
			local Adorments = Debug.Adornments
			
			--assert(type(Adorments) == `table`, `[{script}] table expected, got: {type(Adorments)}`)
			
			debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)

			local Parent = Debug.Parent or workspace
			local Lifetime = tonumber(Debug.Lifetime) or 3
			local Size = Settings and Settings.Size
			
			local ToColor = (RaycastResult and (SettingsTo.ColorResult or COLOR_RESULT)) or (SettingsTo.ColorNoResult or COLOR_NO_RESULT)
			local ToSize = Size or SIZE_TO
			local ToTransparency = tonumber(SettingsTo.Transparency) or TRANSPARENCY
			local ToVisible = not SettingsPath.Visible --and SettingsTo.Visible
			local ToZindex = tonumber(SettingsTo.Zindex) or 3

			local FromColor = SettingsFrom.Color or COLOR_FROM
			local FromSize = Size or SIZE_FROM
			local FromTransparency = tonumber(SettingsFrom.Transparency) or TRANSPARENCY
			local FromVisible = not SettingsPath.Visible
			local FromZindex = tonumber(SettingsFrom.Zindex) or 2
			
			local PathColor = SettingsPath.Color or COLOR_PATH
			local PathTransparency = tonumber(SettingsPath.Transparency) or TRANSPARENCY
			local PathVisible = not SettingsPath.Visible
			local PathZindex = tonumber(SettingsFrom.Zindex) or 1
			
			local HitPosition = RaycastResult and RaycastResult.Position
			local IsNew = false
			local Shape = Settings and Settings.Shape
			--print(Debug.DebounceIndex, Debug.CreateNew, not Debounce.Is(Debug.DebounceIndex))
			local ToCenterOfPosition: Vector3
			local FromPosition: Vector3
			
			if Debug.CreateNew or Debug.Shape ~= Shape or not Debounce.Is(Debug.DebounceIndex) then
				Debounce.New(Debug.DebounceIndex, Lifetime)
				Debug:Clear()
				Debug.CreateNew = false
				IsNew = true
			end
			
			do -- Result
				--[[ 
					TODO 09 FEB 2026
					1. Add Adorment for "from" point ✅
					2. Add support for Blockcast
					3. Make adorments CFrame oreintation relative to directions ✅
				]]
				
				local AdormentFromIndex
				local AdormentToIndex
				local AdormentTo: AdornmentManager.	Manager
				local AdormentFrom: AdornmentManager.Manager
				
				if not Shape or Shape == `Block` then
					
					do -- From
						AdormentFromIndex = `BlockFrom_{Index}`
						AdormentFrom = getmetatable(Adorments[AdormentFromIndex]) and Adorments[AdormentFromIndex] or AdornmentManager("Block")
					end
					
					do -- Result
						AdormentToIndex = `BlockResult_{Index}`
						AdormentTo = getmetatable(Adorments[AdormentToIndex]) and Adorments[AdormentToIndex] or AdornmentManager("Block")
					end
					
					--FinalPosition = RaycastResult and Position + (Direction.Unit * RaycastResult.Distance) or FinalPosition
				elseif Shape == `Ball` then
					
					do -- Result
						local AdormentIndex = `BallResult_{Index}`
						AdormentTo = getmetatable(Adorments[AdormentIndex]) and Adorments[AdormentIndex] or AdornmentManager("Ball")
						Adorments[AdormentIndex] = AdormentTo
					end
					
					--FinalPosition = RaycastResult and Position + (Direction.Unit * RaycastResult.Distance) or FinalPosition
				elseif typeof(Shape) == `Instance` and (Shape :: Instance):IsA(`BasePart`) then
					return warn(`[{script}] Shapecast debug is not supported yet`)
				else
					error(`[{script}] Debug shape {Shape} is not supported`)
				end
				
				local FromCFrame: CFrame
				local ToCFrame: CFrame
				
				do
					if PositionType == `CFrame` then
						FromCFrame = Position
						ToCFrame = (HitPosition and CFrame.new(FromCFrame.Position + (Direction.Unit * RaycastResult.Distance)) * FromCFrame.Rotation) or Position + Direction
					elseif PositionType == `Vector3` then
						local LookAt = HitPosition or (Position + Direction)
						FromCFrame = CFrame.new(Position, LookAt)
						ToCFrame = CFrame.new(LookAt) * FromCFrame.Rotation
					else
						error(`[{script}] CFrame or Vector3 position expected, got: {PositionType}`)
					end
				end
				
				ToCenterOfPosition = ToCFrame.Position
				FromPosition = FromCFrame.Position
				Debug.Shape = Shape
				
				do -- From
					Adorments[AdormentFromIndex] = AdormentFrom
					AdormentFrom:SetSize(FromSize)
						:SetCFrame(FromCFrame)

					--if IsNew then
					AdormentFrom:SetTransparency(FromTransparency)
						:SetColor(FromColor)
						:SetAlwaysOnTop(true)
						:SetVisible(FromVisible)
						:SetZindex(FromZindex)
					--end
				end
				
				do -- To
					Adorments[AdormentToIndex] = AdormentTo
					AdormentTo:SetSize(ToSize)
						:SetCFrame(ToCFrame)
					
					--if IsNew then
						AdormentTo:SetTransparency(ToTransparency)
						:SetColor(ToColor)
						:SetAlwaysOnTop(true)
						:SetVisible(ToVisible)
						:SetZindex(ToZindex)
					--end
				end
			end
			
			do -- Path
				local AdormentIndex = `PyramidPath_{Index}`
				local PathAdorment = getmetatable(Adorments[AdormentIndex]) and Adorments[AdormentIndex] or AdornmentManager("Pyramid")
				Adorments[AdormentIndex] = PathAdorment
				
				PathAdorment:SetSize(Vector3.new(
					ToSize.X,
					(FromPosition - ToCenterOfPosition).Magnitude,
					ToSize.Z
				))
				:SetCFrame(CFrame.new(FromPosition, ToCenterOfPosition))
				
				--if IsNew then
					PathAdorment:SetTransparency(PathTransparency)
					:SetColor(PathColor)
					:SetAlwaysOnTop(true)
					:SetVisible(FromVisible)
					:SetZindex(FromZindex)
					--:SetVisible(true)
				--end
			end
			
			debug.profileend()
		end
		
		--debug.profileend()
	end
	
	function LocalUtils.BulkVisualizeDebug(BulkMethod: (...any)-> (...any), BulkData: BulkDefault, Results: {RaycastResult}, IsPositionTable: boolean, IsDirectionsTable: boolean, IsRPsTable: boolean, IsValues1Table: boolean)
		
		if BulkData.Debug then
			
			local RaycastData = {} :: Default
			RaycastData.Debug = BulkData.Debug
			
			local IsShapecast = BulkMethod == Module.BulkShapecast -- Instead of PositionsTable it will use BasePartsTable
			local IsSpherecast = BulkMethod == Module.BulkSpherecast
			local IsBlockcast = BulkMethod == Module.BulkBlockcast
			local Settings = {}
			Settings.Shape = (IsBlockcast and `Block`) or (IsSpherecast and `Ball`) or nil
			
			for I, Result in Results do
				--print(IsPositionTable)
				RaycastData.Position = IsPositionTable and BulkData.Positions[I] or BulkData.Positions
				RaycastData.Direction = IsDirectionsTable and BulkData.Directions[I] or BulkData.Directions
				--RaycastData.RaycastParams = IsRPsTable and BulkData.RaycastParams[I] or BulkData.RaycastParams
				if IsBlockcast then
					Settings.Size = IsValues1Table and BulkData.Sizes[I] or BulkData.Sizes
				elseif IsSpherecast then
					Settings.Size = (IsValues1Table and BulkData.Radiuses[I] or BulkData.Radiuses)
				end
				
				LocalUtils.VisualizeDebug(
					RaycastData,
					Result,
					Settings,
					I
				)
			end
		end
		
		return Results
	end

	function LocalUtils.ShapecastToBlockcast(ShapecastData: Shapecast)
		local Table = table.clone(ShapecastData) :: Blockcast
		Table.Position = ShapecastData.Position or ShapecastData.Part.Position
		Table.Size = ShapecastData.Part.Size
		return Table
	end

	function LocalUtils.ShapecastToSpherecast(ShapecastData: Shapecast)
		local Table = table.clone(ShapecastData) :: Spherecast
		Table.Position = ShapecastData.Position or ShapecastData.Part.Position
		Table.Radius = ShapecastData.Part.Size.X
		return Table
	end
	
	table.freeze(LocalUtils)
end

			LocalUtils.VisualizeDebug(

			LocalUtils.VisualizeDebug(

				}
			)
			
			return RaycastResult

			local BasePart = ShapecastData.Part :: BasePart

			if BasePart:IsA(`Part`) then
				if BasePart.Shape == Enum.PartType.Block then
					return Module.Blockcast(LocalUtils.ShapecastToBlockcast(ShapecastData))
				elseif BasePart.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then
					return Module.Spherecast(LocalUtils.ShapecastToSpherecast(ShapecastData))
				end
			end
			
			local ShapePart, Position do
				if ShapecastData.UseOriginal then
					ShapePart = BasePart
					Position = ShapePart.Position
				else
					ShapePart = Instance.fromExisting(BasePart)
					Position = ShapecastData.Position and ShapecastData.Position or ShapePart.Position
					ShapePart.Position = Position
				end
			end
			
			local Direction = ShapecastData.Direction
			local RaycastResult = ShapecastData.Parallel and Manager:SetWork(`{debug.info(1, `n`)}`, ShapePart, Direction, ShapecastData.RaycastParams) or Methods[`{debug.info(1, `n`)}`](ShapePart, Direction, ShapecastData.RaycastParams)

					Size = ShapePart.Size
				}
			)
			
			return RaycastResult, not ShapecastData.UseOriginal and ShapePart:Destroy()
		end
	end

		function Module.BulkSpherecast(Bulk: BulkSherecast): {[any]: RaycastResult}

local Module = {}
local BasicPool = {}

export type Pool = typeof(BasicPool)
export type BasicPool = typeof(Module)

do
	
	BasicPool.__index = BasicPool
	BasicPool._Pool = nil :: {[any]: any}
	BasicPool._Registred = nil :: {[any]: boolean}
	BasicPool._RegistredTotal = nil :: number
	BasicPool._Next = nil :: any
	BasicPool._Total = nil :: number

	--[[
		Determinate that this object (not)linked to this pool
	]]
	function BasicPool.SetRegister(self: Pool, Index: any, Registr: boolean?)
		local Registred = self._Registred
		local IsExist = Registred[Index]
		local IsAdding = Registr == true
		
		if IsAdding then
			if not IsExist then
				Registred[Index] = true
				self._RegistredTotal += 1
			end
		else
			if IsExist then
				Registred[Index] = nil
				self._RegistredTotal -= 1
			end
		end
	end

	function BasicPool.GetTotalRegistred(self: Pool)
		return self._RegistredTotal
	end

	--[[
		Add object to pool
	]]
	function BasicPool.Set(self: Pool, Value: any)
		self._Pool[Value] = Value
		self._Total += 1
	end

	--[[
		Get object from pool
	]]
	function BasicPool.Get(self: Pool)
		local Pool = self._Pool
		local Value = next(Pool)
		
		if Value then
			Pool[Value] = nil
			self._Total -= 1
		end
		
		return Value
	end

	--[[
		Get (without pulling out Object from pool)
	]]
	function BasicPool.Next(self: Pool)
		local Pool = self._Pool
		local PrevNext = self._Next
		local Next
		if Pool[PrevNext] then
			Next = next(Pool, PrevNext) or next(Pool)
			self._Next = Next
			return Next
		else
			Next = next(Pool)
			self._Next = Next
		end
		
		return Next
	end

	--[[
		Get raw pool of objects

local Module = {}

export type Color3 = typeof(Module) & typeof(Color3)

local RNG = Random.new()
local NextNumber = RNG.NextNumber

do type([[ Copying from Color3 table ]])
	for I, V in Color3 do
		Module[I] = V
	end
end

do type([[ Own values/methods ]])
	
	--[[
		Invert Color3
	]]
	function Module.invert(Color: Color3): Color3
		return Color3.new(1 - Color.R, 1 - Color.G, 1 - Color.B)
	end
	
	--[[
		Darken Color3 by (from 0 to 1 range) amount
	]]
	function Module.darken(Color: Color3, Amount: number): Color3
		Amount = (1 - math.clamp(Amount, 0, 1))
		return Color3.new(Color.R * Amount, Color.G * Amount, Color.B * Amount)
	end
	
	--[[
		Return random color between 0 and 1
	]]
	function Module.random(Min: number?, Max: number?): Color3
		assert((not Min and not Max) or (tonumber(Min) and tonumber(Max)), `[{script}] Min and Max number expected, got Min: {Min}, Max: {Max}`)
		Min = Min or 0
		Max = Max or 1
		
		return Color3.new(NextNumber(RNG, Min, Max), NextNumber(RNG, Min, Max), NextNumber(RNG, Min, Max))
	end
	
	do
		local maxUInt32 = 4294967296
		local maxInt32 = 2147483647

		local function HashCode(String: string)
			local val = 0

			local n = #String

			for i = 1, n do
				val = (val + String:byte(i) * math.pow(31, n - i)) % maxUInt32
			end

			return math.abs(val > maxInt32 and val - maxUInt32 or val)
		end
		
		--[[
			Convert string to Color3
		]]
		function Module.fromHash(Hash: string?)
			assert(type(Hash) == `string`, `[{script}] String expected, got: {typeof(Hash)}`)
			
			local HasedNumber = HashCode(Hash)
			local R = HasedNumber % 255
			local G = (HasedNumber // 2) % 255
			local B = (HasedNumber // 3) % 255

			return Color3.fromRGB(R, G, B)
		end
	end
end

return table.freeze(Module) :: Color3

export type Prioritizer = typeof(Module)
export type PriorityData = {
	(Value: any)-> () & {[number]: any}
}

local Priorities = {} :: {[any]: PriorityData}
local PrioritizerIndexes = {
	Function = 1,
	Data = 2,
	DefaultValue = 3,
}

do
	Module.GetPriorities = function()
		return Priorities
	end

	Module.GetDefault = function(Index)
		return Priorities[Index] and Priorities[Index][PrioritizerIndexes.DefaultValue]
	end

	Module.Get = function(Index: any): PriorityData
		return Priorities[Index]
	end

	Module.Set = function(Index: any, Function: (Value: any, Priority: number | string, ...any?)-> ()?, DefaultValue: any?, ...): ()

		assert(not Function or type(Function) == `function`, `[{script}] Function expected, got {typeof(Function)}`)

		if Function then
			Priorities[Index] = {
				[PrioritizerIndexes.Function] = Function,
				[PrioritizerIndexes.Data] = {},
				[PrioritizerIndexes.DefaultValue] = DefaultValue
			}

			if DefaultValue then
				Function(DefaultValue, ...)
			end
		else
			Priorities[Index] = nil
		end

	end

	Module.SetValue = function(Index: any, Priority: number?, NewValue: any, ValueIndex: any?, ...): ()
		local ValueIndex = ValueIndex or ``
		local Is = Priorities[Index]

		if Is then
			debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}_{Index}`)
			assert(not Priority or type(Priority) == `number`, `[{script}] Number expected, got {typeof(Priority)}`)
			--local obed = tonumber(Priority) or warn(`got`, Priority)
			--print(Is[2][tonumber(Priority) or 1], Value)
			local PriorityData = {tonumber(Priority) or 1, NewValue}
			local Priorities = Is[PrioritizerIndexes.Data]
			Priorities[ValueIndex] = PriorityData
			--Is[2][tonumber(Priority) or 1] = NewValue
			--print(Is[2][tonumber(Priority) or 1], Value)

			local Priority, Value, ValueIndex

			for I, Data in Priorities do
				if not Priority or Priority < Data[1] then
					Priority, Value, ValueIndex = Data[1], Data[2], I
				end
			end

			debug.profileend()

			if Value == nil and Is[PrioritizerIndexes.DefaultValue] ~= nil then
				Is[PrioritizerIndexes.Function](Is[PrioritizerIndexes.DefaultValue], `Default`, ValueIndex, ...)
			else
				--print(NewValue, Value)
				Is[PrioritizerIndexes.Function](Value, Priority, ValueIndex, ...)
			end
		else
			warn(`[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} not found: {Index}` )
		end
	end
end

return table.freeze(Module) :: Prioritizer

local Destroyer = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild(`Destroyer`))

do type([[ Trove ]])
	Trove.__index = Trove
	Trove.Objects = nil :: {[any]: {any}}
	Trove.UniqueID = nil :: number
	Trove.Traceback = nil :: string
	Trove.Name = nil :: any
	Trove.Stats = nil :: {
		Extended: number,
	}
	--[[
		Create new Trove that attached to previous
	]]
	function Trove.Extend(self: Trove, Name: string?): Trove
		local Stats = self.Stats
		Stats.Extended += 1
		
		return self:Add(Module.New(Name or `{self.Name}_{Stats.Extended}`))
	end
	
	--[[
		Clone a Instance.
		You can use Trove:Add(Instance.fromExisting(YourInstance)) instead
	]]
	function Trove.InstanceFrom<self, FromInstance>(self: Trove, FromInstance: FromInstance, Parent: Instance?, Name: string?): FromInstance
		local NewInstance = Instance.fromExisting(FromInstance)
		NewInstance.Parent = Parent
		NewInstance.Name = Name or NewInstance.Name
		
		return self:Add(NewInstance)
	end
	
	--[[
		Clone a Instance.
		You can use Trove:Add(YourInstance:Clone()) instead
	]]
	function Trove.InstanceClone<self, CloneInstance>(self: Trove, Instance: CloneInstance, Parent: Instance?, Name: string?): CloneInstance
		local NewInstance = Instance:Clone()
		NewInstance.Parent = Parent
		NewInstance.Name = Name or NewInstance.Name
		
		return self:Add(NewInstance)
	end

	function Trove.BindToRenderStep(self: Trove, Priority: Enum.RenderPriority | number, Function: (dt: number)->(), OnUnbind: ()->()?)
		
		local Index = math.random()
		Destroyer:BindToRenderStep(Index, Priority, Function)
		return self:Add(Index, OnUnbind, function() Destroyer:UnbindFromRenderStep(Index) end)
	end
	
	--[[
		Add object and attachment to Trove (Object destroyed == attachments destroyed)
	]]
	function Trove.Add<self, Object...>(self: Trove, Object: Object, ...): Object...
		
		local CheckExist = self.Objects[Object]
		if CheckExist then
			return warn(`[{script}] Trying to add existing Object`, Object, `Traceback:`, {debug.traceback()})
		else
			self.Objects[Object] = {...}
			return Object, ...--, function() self:Remove(Object) end
		end
	end
	
	--[[
		Remove object from Trove
	]]
	function Trove.Remove(self: Trove, Object: any, Destroy: boolean?): boolean
		local ObjectTable = self.Objects[Object]
		if ObjectTable then
			
			if Destroy then
				if type(Object) == "function" then
					Object(table.unpack(ObjectTable))
				else
					Destroyer.Destroy(Object)
					
					for _, Arg in ObjectTable do
						if type(Arg) == "function" then
							Arg()
						else
							Destroyer.Destroy(Arg)
						end
					end
				end
			end
			
			self.Objects[Object] = nil
			return true
		end
		
		return false, error(`[{script}] Object not found: {Object} {self.Name} {self.UniqueID}`)
	end
	
	--[[
		When Instance is destroyed, Trove will be also destroyed
	]]
	function Trove.AttachToInstance(self: Trove, Instance: Instance, OnDestroy: (...any)-> (), ...: any): RBXScriptConnection
		
		--print(Inst, Inst:IsDescendantOf(game))
		assert(Instance and typeof(Instance) == `Instance`, `[{script}] Instance expected, got {Instance} {typeof(Instance)}`)
			
		local All = {...}
		
		return self:Add(Instance.Destroying:Once(function()
			
			if getmetatable(self) then
				self:Destroy()	
			end
			
			if type(OnDestroy) == `function` then
				OnDestroy(table.unpack(All))
			end
		end))
	end
	
	--[[
		Clear Trove from objects
	]]
	function Trove.Clear(self: Trove, DestroyObjects: boolean?): ()
		for Object, _ in self.Objects do
			self:Remove(Object, DestroyObjects)
		end
	end
	
	--[[
		Destroy Trove and all Objects
	]]
	function Trove.Destroy(self: Trove): ()
		assert(not table.isfrozen(self), `[{script}] Unable to destroy frozen Trove`)
		self:Clear(true)
		setmetatable(self, nil)
	end
	
	table.freeze(Trove)
	
	do
		Destroyer.AddTableDestroy(`{script}`, function(Table)
			if getmetatable(Table) == Trove then
				(Table :: Trove):Destroy()
				return true
			end
		end)
	end
end

		if typeof(Inst) == `Instance` then

		end

--[[
	Pack args in table (if not single table)
]]
function Utils.PackOnce<Any...>(...): {[number]: any}
	
	local Packed = {...}
	
	for _, Any in Packed do
		if type(Any) ~= `table` then
			return Packed
		end
	end
	
	return #Packed > 1 and Packed or ...
end

--[[
	Create Model and set Instances as childrens of Model
]]
function Utils.Group(Instances: Instance | {Instance}, Paste: boolean?): Model
	--debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)
	
	local Model = Instance.new("Model")
	local LastParent
	
	for _, Inst in Utils.PackOnce(Instances) do
		LastParent = Inst.Parent
		Inst.Parent = Model
	end
	
	Model.Parent = Paste and LastParent
	
	--debug.profileend()
	return Model
end

--[[
	Ungroup childrens of Group
]]
function Utils.Ungroup(Group: Instance | {Instance}, Into: Instance?, DestroyGroup: boolean?): ()
	for _, Group in Utils.PackOnce(Group) do
		for _, Inst in Group:GetChildren() do
			Inst.Parent = Into or Group.Parent
		end
		
		if DestroyGroup then
			Group:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function Utils.WaitForChild(Settings: FindChildSettings): Instance?
	
	local Name = Settings.Name and `{Settings.Name}` or nil
	local Where = Settings.Where
	local Timer = Settings.Timer
	local IsAPack = Settings.IsA and Utils.PackOnce(Settings.IsA) or nil :: {Instances}?
	local NoWarn = Settings.NoWarn
	
	local function CheckIsA(Any: Instance)		
		for _, IsA in IsAPack do
			if Any:IsA(IsA) then
				return Any
			end
		end
	end
	
	Utils.Assert(Where, `[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} got no Settings.Where`)

	Timer = tonumber(Timer) and Timer or 7
	local TimePassed = 0
	local Found: Instance?
	
	repeat
		if Name then
			
			Found = Where:FindFirstChild(Name, Settings.Recurcive)
			if IsAPack and Found then
				Found = CheckIsA(Found)
			end
			
		elseif IsAPack then
			
			for _, IsA in IsAPack do
				local IntermediateResult = Where:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(IsA, Settings.Recurcive)
				if IntermediateResult then
					Found = IntermediateResult
					break
				end
			end
		else
			return error(`[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} no IsA or Name`)
		end
		
		TimePassed += Timer > 0 and task.wait() or 0
		
		if script:GetAttribute(`Debug`) then
			print(Where, Name, table.unpack(IsAPack or {}))
		end
		
	until Found or TimePassed >= Timer
	
	if not Found and not NoWarn then
		warn(`[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)}`, {
			Where,
			Name, 
			table.unpack(IsAPack or {}), 
			{debug.traceback()},
		})
	end
	
	return Found
end

function Utils.FindFirstChild(Settings: FindChildSettings): Instance?
	Settings.Timer = 0
	return Utils.WaitForChild(Settings)
end

--[[

function Utils.FindOrCreate(Settings: FindChildSettings & {Properties: {[string]: any}?})
	Settings.NoWarn = true or not Services.RunService:IsStudio() -- true
	local Found = Utils.FindFirstChild(Settings) --Utils.FindFirstChild(Settings)
	
	if Found then
		return Found
	elseif Settings.Where then
		local Inst = Instance.new(Settings.IsA) :: Instance
		Inst.Name = Settings.Name or Inst.Name
		
		for I, Value in Settings.Properties or {} do
			Inst[I] = Value
		end
		
		Inst.Parent = Settings.Where
		return Inst
	end
end

--[[

]]
function Utils.GetEverything(Instances: Instance | {Instance}, IsA: Instances? | {Instances}?): {Instance?}
	--debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)
	
	local Everything = {}
	
	for _, Inst in Utils.PackOnce(Instances) :: {Instance} do
		local Descendants = Inst:GetDescendants()
		table.insert(Descendants, Inst)
		
		if IsA then
			local IsAGroup = Utils.PackOnce(IsA) :: {Instances}
			for _, Descendant in Descendants do
				for _, ClassName in IsAGroup do
					if Descendant:IsA(ClassName) then
						table.insert(Everything, Descendant)
						break
					end
				end
			end
		else
			for _, Descendant in Descendants do
				table.insert(Everything, Descendant)
			end
		end
	end
	
	--debug.profileend()
	return Everything
end

	if TypeType == `string` then

		if LowerStringType ~= `string` then

		else

		return AnyType == TypeType
	end

--[[
	Clamp CFrame in a box
]]
function Utils.CFrameClamp(Center: CFrame, To_Clamp: CFrame, Size: Vector3): CFrame
	local HalfSize = Size / 2
	local Min, Max = -HalfSize, HalfSize
	local LocalFollowPosition = Center:Inverse() * To_Clamp.Position
	local ClampedLocalPosition = Vector3.new(
		math.clamp(LocalFollowPosition.X, Min.X, Max.X),
		math.clamp(LocalFollowPosition.Y, Min.Y, Max.Y),
		math.clamp(LocalFollowPosition.Z, Min.Z, Max.Z)
	)

	return Center * CFrame.new(ClampedLocalPosition)
end

--[[
	https://devforum.roblox.com/t/getboundingbox-for-tools-and-accessories-and-possibly-more/1843092/2
]]
function Utils.CalculateBoundingBox(basisCFrame: CFrame, allParts: {BasePart}, allAttachments: {Attachment}?): (Vector3, Vector3)
	local inverseBasis = basisCFrame:Inverse()
	local xmin, xmax = math.huge, -math.huge
	local ymin, ymax = math.huge, -math.huge
	local zmin, zmax = math.huge, -math.huge

	for _, part in allParts do
		local cframe = part.CFrame
		local size = part.Size
		local sx, sy, sz = size.X, size.Y, size.Z

		-- Calculation for bounding box in the space of basisCFrame1
		local localCFrame1 = inverseBasis * cframe -- put cframe in our local basis
		local _, _, _,
		t00, t01, t02,
		t10, t11, t12,
		t20, t21, t22 = localCFrame1:components()
		local hw = 0.5 * (math.abs(sx * t00) + math.abs(sy * t01) + math.abs(sz * t02))
		local hh = 0.5 * (math.abs(sx * t10) + math.abs(sy * t11) + math.abs(sz * t12))
		local hd = 0.5 * (math.abs(sx * t20) + math.abs(sy * t21) + math.abs(sz * t22))
		local x, y, z = localCFrame1.X, localCFrame1.Y, localCFrame1.Z
		xmin = math.min(xmin, x - hw)
		xmax = math.max(xmax, x + hw)
		ymin = math.min(ymin, y - hh)
		ymax = math.max(ymax, y + hh)
		zmin = math.min(zmin, z - hd)
		zmax = math.max(zmax, z + hd)
	end
	
	for _, attachment in (allAttachments or {}) do
		local localPosition = basisCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(attachment.WorldPosition)
		local x, y, z = localPosition.X, localPosition.Y, localPosition.Z
		xmin = math.min(xmin, x)
		xmax = math.max(xmax, x)
		ymin = math.min(ymin, y)
		ymax = math.max(ymax, y)
		zmin = math.min(zmin, z)
		zmax = math.max(zmax, z)
	end

	local boundingBoxOffset = Vector3.new(
		0.5 * (xmin + xmax),
		0.5 * (ymin + ymax),
		0.5 * (zmin + zmax)
	)
	local boundingBoxSize = Vector3.new(
		xmax - xmin,
		ymax - ymin,
		zmax - zmin
	)

	return boundingBoxOffset, boundingBoxSize
end

--[[
	Instead of returning CFrame first it returns size

function Utils.GetBoundingBox(Object: Instance): (Vector3, CFrame)
	--debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)
	local BaseParts = Object:QueryDescendants(`BasePart`) :: {BasePart}
	local BasisCFrame = Utils.GetPivot(Object)
