function Utils.GetPivot(Object: Instance): CFrame?
	if Object:IsA("Model") then
		local PrimaryPart = Utils.GetPrimaryPart(Object)
		return PrimaryPart and PrimaryPart.CFrame
	elseif Object:IsA("BasePart") then
		return Object:GetPivot()
	elseif Object:IsA("Accessory") then
		local BasePart = Object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") :: BasePart
		return BasePart and BasePart:GetPivot()
	else
		warn(`[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} {Object} {typeof(Object)}`)
	end

--[[
	Fit object in Camera view
]]
function Utils.GetFitDistance(Inst: Instance, Camera: Camera, GuiObject: GuiObject?)
	local Object_Size = Utils.GetBoundingBox(Inst)
	local GuiObject_Size = GuiObject and GuiObject.AbsoluteSize or workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize

	-- clamped b/c we only want to scale the xfov2 if width < height
	-- otherwise if width > height then xfov2 == yfov2
	local wh = math.min(1, GuiObject_Size.X / GuiObject_Size.Y)
	local yfov2 = math.rad(Camera.FieldOfView / 2)
	local xfov2 = math.atan(math.tan(yfov2) * wh)
	local Radius = Object_Size.Magnitude / 2

	return Radius / math.sin(xfov2)
end

--[[
	Convert tables to string
]]
function Utils.ToString(Table: any, Depth: number?)
	--debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)
	
	if type(Table) ~= 'table' then
		return `{typeof(Table)} {Table}` --tostring(Table)
	elseif not next(Table) then
		return '{}'
	end

	local Spaces = 4
	local Depth = Depth or 1
	local UseSemiColon = false

	local Space = (" "):rep(Depth * Spaces)
	local Sep = UseSemiColon and ";" or ","
	local ConcatenationBuilder = {"{"}

	for k, x in next, Table do
		table.insert(ConcatenationBuilder, 
			("\n%s[%s] = %s%s"):format(Space, type(k)=='number' and `{k}` or ('"%s"'):format(`{k}`), Utils.ToString(x, Depth + 1), Sep))
	end

	local ConcatedTable = table.concat(ConcatenationBuilder)
	
	--debug.profileend()
	return ("%s\n%s}"):format(ConcatedTable:sub(1, -2), Space:sub(1, - Spaces - 1))
end

				--ConvertedStr ..= NumSymbols[Char]--.." "
			end
		end
		
		--debug.profileend()
		return Converted_Number
	end

--[[

local Module = {}

export type table = typeof(Module) & typeof(table)

do type([[ Copying from table table ]])
	for I, V in table do
		Module[I] = V
	end
end

do
	
	do
		local CloneMethods = {
			table = function(Table) return Module.deepClone(Table) end,
			SharedTable = function(Table) return SharedTable.clone(Table, true) end,
		}
		
		--[[
			Clone table with every subtables
		]]
		function Module.deepClone<Table>(Table: Table): Table
			local clone = table.clone(Table) 

			-- Loop through the original table to check for table values
			-- If a table is found as a value, deep clone it to the key (index)
			for I, Value in Table do
				
				
				local TypeOf = typeof(Value)
				
				if CloneMethods[TypeOf] then
					clone[I] = CloneMethods[TypeOf](Value)
				else
					clone[I] = Value
				end
			end

			-- Return the finalized copy of the deep cloned table
			return clone
		end
	end
	
	--[[
		Freeze table and every subtables
	]]
	function Module.deepFreeze<Table>(Table: Table): Table
		table.freeze(Table)

		-- Check each key of the table and freeze it if it's a table
		for _, value in Table do
			-- Make sure the value isn't frozen; if it already is, an error will occur
			if type(value) == "table" and table.isfrozen(value) == false then
				Module.deepFreeze(value)
			end
		end
		
		return Table
	end
	
	--[[
		Merge 2 tables values into 1
		(Will return Table2)
	]]
	function Module.merge<Table1, Table2>(Table1, Table2, DeepClone: boolean?): Table1 & Table2
		if DeepClone then
			Table1, Table2 = Module.deepClone(Table1), Module.deepClone(Table2)
		end
		
		for I, Value in Table1 do
			Table2[I] = Value
		end
		
		return Table2
	end
	
	--[[
		You this if you want to send RaycastResult from (Client to Server) or (Server to Client)
	]]
	function Module.raycastresultClone(RaycastResult: RaycastResult): RaycastResult
		return {
			Instance = RaycastResult.Instance,
			Position = RaycastResult.Position,
			Normal = RaycastResult.Normal,
			Distance = RaycastResult.Distance,
			Material = RaycastResult.Material,
		}
	end
	
	--[[
		Check if table is empty
	]]
	function Module.isEmpty(Table: {[any]: any}): boolean
		return next(Table) == nil
	end
	
	--[[
		Get length of table
	]]
	function Module.length(Table: {[any]: any}): number
		local Number = 0
		for _, _ in Table do
			Number += 1
		end
		return Number
	end
end

return table.freeze(Module) :: table

function Module.unpack(Vec: vector | Vector3 | Vector2): (number, number, number?)
	local Type = typeof(Vec)
	
	assert(Type == `Vector3` or Type == `Vector2`, `[{script}] Vector expected, got {Type}`)

	assert((not Min and not Max) or (tonumber(Min) and tonumber(Max)), `[{script}] Min and Max number expected, got Min: {Min}, Max: {Max}`)
	Min = Min or 0
	Max = Max or 1
	
	return vector.create(NextNumber(RNG, Min, Max), NextNumber(RNG, Min, Max), NextNumber(RNG, Min, Max))

	end

local Manager = {} 
export type Manager = typeof(Manager)
do
	
	if not IsVM then
		Manager.__index = Manager
		Manager._Actors = nil :: {[number]: Actor}
		Manager._Container = nil :: Instance
		Manager._BaseScript = nil :: BaseScript
		Manager._NextNumber = nil :: number
		Manager._Topics = nil :: {[string]: boolean}
		Manager._Working = nil :: {[any]: boolean?}
		Manager._InitTimeout = nil :: number
		Manager._ActorsCount = nil :: number
		Manager.OnActorsAmountChange = nil :: (NewAmount: number, OldAmount: number)-> ()?
		
		do type([[ Sync ]])
			
			function Manager.SetWork(self: Manager, Topic: string, ...:any?): (...any) -- Говорим о том что работа создаётся
				local ThisThread = coroutine.running()
				
				self:SetWorkAsync(Topic, function(...)
					task.defer(ThisThread, ...)
				end, ...)
				
				return coroutine.yield()
			end
			
			function Manager.SetWorks(self: Manager, Total: number, Topic: string, ...:any): ({[number]: any?})
				local ThisThread = coroutine.running()

				self:SetWorksAsync(Total, Topic, function(...)
					task.defer(ThisThread, ...)
				end, ...)

				return coroutine.yield()
			end
			
			function Manager.SetAllWork(self: Manager, Topic: string, ...:any): ({[number]: any?})
				local ThisThread = coroutine.running()

				self:SetAllWorkAsync(Topic, function(...)
					task.defer(ThisThread, ...)
				end, ...)

				return coroutine.yield()
			end
			
			function Manager.SetWorkFromTo(self: Manager, Total: number, Topic: string, StartIndex: number, EndIndex: number, ...:any?)
				local ThisThread = coroutine.running()

				self:SetWorkFromToAsync(Topic, function(...)
					task.defer(ThisThread, ...)
				end, StartIndex, EndIndex, ...)

				return coroutine.yield()
			end
		end
		
		do type([[ Async ]])
			
			function Manager.WorkAsync(self: Manager, Actor: Actor, Topic: string, Index: any, OnComplete: (...any)-> ()?, ...:any?): (...any)
				
				debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)
				
				if not self._Topics[Topic] then
					return warn(`[{script}] {debug.info(2, `n`)}, no actors found`)
				end
				
				local Unique
				repeat
					Unique = `{Topic}_{Index}_{math.random()}`
				until not self._Working[Unique]

				self._Bindable:Once(Unique, function(...)
					self._Working[Unique] = nil

					if type(OnComplete) == `function` then
						task.defer(OnComplete, ...)
					end
				end)

				Actor:SendMessage(Topic, Unique, ...)
				
				debug.profileend()
				
				return Unique
			end
			
			function Manager.SetWorkAsync(self: Manager, Topic: string, OnComplete: (...any)-> ()?, ...:any?) -- Говорим о том что работа создаётся
				
				local Actor, NextNumber = self:GetNextActor()

				if Actor then
					return self:WorkAsync(Actor, Topic, NextNumber, OnComplete, ...)
				else
					return warn(`[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)}, no actors found`)
				end
			end
			
			--[[Invoke n-time a]]
			function Manager.SetWorksAsync(self: Manager, Total: number, Topic: string, OnComplete: (...any)-> ()?, ...:any?) -- Говорим о том что работа создаётся
				local Results = {}
				local Completed = 0
				
				if Total ~= Total or Total < 1 then
					return Results
				end
				
				for I = 1, Total do
					self:SetWorkAsync(Topic, function(Result)
						Completed += 1
						Results[I] = {Result}
						
						if Completed >= Total then
							task.defer(OnComplete, Results)
						end
					end)
				end
			end
			
			function Manager.SetWorkFromToAsync(self: Manager, Topic: string, OnComplete: (...any)-> ()?, StartIndex: number, EndIndex: number, ...:any?)
				assert(tonumber(StartIndex), `[{script}] StartIndex is not a number: {StartIndex}`)
				assert(tonumber(EndIndex), `[{script}] EndIndex is not a number: {EndIndex}`)
				assert(EndIndex < StartIndex, `[{script}] EndIndex is smaller than StartIndex`)
				
				local Results = {}
				local Completed = 0
				local Iteration = 0
				local Total = EndIndex - StartIndex
				
				for I, Actor in self._Actors do
					Iteration += 1
					
					if Iteration >= StartIndex and Iteration <= EndIndex then
						
						local MyIteration = Iteration
						
						self:WorkAsync(Actor, Topic, I, function(Result)
							Completed += 1
							Results[MyIteration] = {Result}

							if OnComplete and Completed >= Total then
								task.defer(OnComplete, Results)
							end
						end, ...)
					end
				end
			end
			
			--[[Inove all actors]]
			function Manager.SetAllWorkAsync(self: Manager, Topic: string, OnComplete: (...any)-> ()?, ...:any?)
				
				local Results = {}
				local Iteration = 0
				local Completed = 0
				local Total = self:GetActorsCount() -- #self._Actors
				
				for I, Actor in self._Actors do
					Iteration += 1
					local MyIteration = Iteration
					self:WorkAsync(Actor, Topic, I, function(Result)
						Completed += 1
						Results[MyIteration] = {Result}

						if OnComplete and Completed >= Total then
							task.defer(OnComplete, Results)
						end
					end, ...)
				end
			end
		end
		
		do type([[ Other ]])
			function Manager.GetActors(self: Manager, RespectArray: boolean?)
				if RespectArray then
					local Iteration = 0
					local Array = {}
					
					for _, Actor in self._Actors do
						Iteration += 1
						Array[Iteration] = Actor
					end
					
					return Array
				else
					return table.clone(self._Actors)
				end
			end
			
			function Manager.GetActorsCount(self: Manager): number
				return GetTableLenght(self._Actors)
			end
			
			function Manager.SetActorsCount(self: Manager, Count: number): ()
				local ThisThread = coroutine.running()
				local Actors = self._Actors
				local CurrentActorsCount = GetTableLenght(Actors)
				local ReturnedResult = 0

				local function ScriptTimeout(Actor: Actor, BaseScript: BasePart)
					if Actor:IsDescendantOf(game) then
						warn(`[{script}] Script init timeout: {BaseScript}`)
					end
					--Actor:Destroy()
					self._Bindable:Disconnect(Actor)
					self._Bindable:Fires(ThisThread)
				end

				if Count >= 1 then

					if Count > CurrentActorsCount then -- Add

						local Difference = Count - CurrentActorsCount

						self._Bindable:Connect(`{ThisThread}`, function()
							ReturnedResult += 1
							--print(Difference)
							if ReturnedResult >= Difference then
								self._Bindable:Disconnect(`{ThisThread}`)
								task.defer(ThisThread)
							end
						end)

						for I = CurrentActorsCount + 1, Count do
							local Actor = Instance.new(`Actor`)
							local BaseScript = self._BaseScript:Clone()-- Instance.fromExisting(self._BaseScript)
							local ThreadDelay = task.delay(self._InitTimeout, ScriptTimeout, Actor, BaseScript)
							
							BaseScript.Destroying:Connect(function()
								
								if Actors[Actor] then
									Actors[Actor] = nil
									self._Bindable:Disconnect(Actor)
									Actor:Destroy()
									local OldActorsAmount = self:GetActorsCount() -- GetTableLenght(Actors)
									local NewActorsAmount = OldActorsAmount - 1
									self._ActorsCount = NewActorsAmount
									
									if type(self.OnActorsAmountChange) == `function` then
										self.OnActorsAmountChange(NewActorsAmount, OldActorsAmount, true)
									end
								end
							end)
							
							self._Bindable:Once(Actor, function(Topics: {[string]: boolean})
								local OldActorsAmount = self:GetActorsCount()
								self._Topics = self._Topics or table.freeze(Topics)
								task.cancel(ThreadDelay)
								self._Actors[Actor] = Actor
								self._Bindable:Fires(`{ThisThread}`)
								local NewActorsAmount = OldActorsAmount + 1
								self._ActorsCount = NewActorsAmount
								
								if type(self.OnActorsAmountChange) == `function` then
									self.OnActorsAmountChange(NewActorsAmount, OldActorsAmount, false)
								end
							end)

							Actor.Parent = self._Container
							BaseScript.Parent = Actor
							BaseScript.Enabled = true
						end
						
						return coroutine.yield()

					elseif Count < CurrentActorsCount then -- Remove

						for I = CurrentActorsCount, Count + 1, -1 do
							local Actor = next(Actors) --Actors[I]
							if Actor then
								Actors[Actor] = nil
								self._Bindable:Disconnect(Actor)
								Actor:Destroy()
							end
						end
						
						self._ActorsCount = Count
						
						if type(self.OnActorsAmountChange) == `function` then
							task.defer(self.OnActorsAmountChange, Count, CurrentActorsCount, true)
						end
					end
				else
					warn(`[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} a number equal to 1 or greater was expected, got: {Count}`)
				end
			end

			function Manager.GetNextActor(self: Manager): (Actor, number)
				
				local NowTick = tick()
				
				--debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)
				
				local Actors = self._Actors
				local NextNumber = next(Actors, self._NextNumber) or next(Actors) --math.max(1, (self._NextNumber + 1) % (#Actors + 1))
				self._NextNumber = NextNumber
				
				--debug.profileend()
				
				--local Passed = tick() - NowTick
				
				--if Passed > 0.0005 then
				--	warn(Passed)
				--end
				
				return Actors[NextNumber], NextNumber
			end
			
			function Manager.Destroy(self: Manager)
				
				for I, Actor in self._Actors do
					self._Actors[I] = nil
					Actor:Destroy()
				end
				
				setmetatable(self, nil)
			end
		end
			
		table.freeze(Manager)
		
	end
	
	--[[
		Create manager for VM scripts
	]]
	function Module.CreateManager(Container: Instance, BaseScript: BaseScript?): Manager
		
		assert(not IsVM, `[{script}] Trying to create Serial Manager in VM`)
		
		if BaseScript then
			
			assert(typeof(BaseScript) == `Instance` and (BaseScript:IsA(`LocalScript`) or BaseScript:IsA(`Script`)), `[{script}] LocalScript or Script expected, got {typeof(BaseScript) == `Instance` and BaseScript.ClassName or typeof(BaseScript)}`)
			
			if Service_Run:IsClient() then
				if BaseScript.ClassName == `Script` then
					--print(BaseScript, BaseScript.RunContext)
					assert(BaseScript.RunContext == Enum.RunContext.Client, `[{script}] Trying to parallel server script: {BaseScript}`)
				elseif BaseScript:IsA(`LocalScript`) then
					assert(Container:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.PlayerGui)
						or 
						Container:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts)
						or
						Container:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Character)
						or
						Container:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Backpack)
						or
						Container:IsDescendantOf(Service_ReplicatedFirst),
						`[{script}] LocalScript undable to excecute in current data model. Docs: https://create.roblox.com/docs/projects/data-model#client`
					)
				end
			else
				-- Server
			end
		else
			if Service_Run:IsClient() then
				BaseScript = WorkerScripts:WaitForChild(`ActorClient`):WaitForChild(`Client`)
			else
				BaseScript = WorkerScripts:WaitForChild(`ActorServer`):WaitForChild(`Server`)
			end
		end
		
		if Container then
			assert(typeof(Container) == `Instance`, `[{script}] Instance expected, got {typeof(Container)}`)
			assert(Container:IsDescendantOf(game), `[{script}] Container is not descendant of game`)
		end
		
		local BindableIndex = require(script:WaitForChild(`BindableIndex`))
		local Bindable = BindableIndex.New()
		
		do
			local BindableInstance = Bindable:GetInstance()
			BindableInstance.Name = Names.Bindable
			BindableInstance.Parent = Container
		end
		
		do
			if not Container:FindFirstChild(Names.ObjectValue) then
				local ObjectValue = Instance.new(`ObjectValue`)
				ObjectValue.Name = Names.ObjectValue
				ObjectValue.Value = script
				ObjectValue.Parent = Container
			end
		end
		
		local self = setmetatable({}, Manager) :: Manager
		self._Container = Container
		self._BaseScript = BaseScript
		self._Bindable = Bindable
		self._NextNumber = nil
		self._InitTimeout = 3
		self._Working = {}
		self._Actors = {}
		self._ActorsCount = 0
		self:SetActorsCount(1) -- Needed to get script's topics
		
		return self
	end
end

local Module = {}
local BasicPool = {}

export type Pool = typeof(BasicPool)
export type BasicPool = typeof(Module)

do
	
	BasicPool.__index = BasicPool
	BasicPool._Pool = nil :: {[any]: any}
	BasicPool._Registred = nil :: {[any]: boolean}
	BasicPool._RegistredTotal = nil :: number
	BasicPool._Next = nil :: any
	BasicPool._Total = nil :: number

	--[[
		Determinate that this object (not)linked to this pool
	]]
	function BasicPool.SetRegister(self: Pool, Index: any, Registr: boolean?)
		local Registred = self._Registred
		local IsExist = Registred[Index]
		local IsAdding = Registr == true
		
		if IsAdding then
			if not IsExist then
				Registred[Index] = true
				self._RegistredTotal += 1
			end
		else
			if IsExist then
				Registred[Index] = nil
				self._RegistredTotal -= 1
			end
		end
	end

	function BasicPool.GetTotalRegistred(self: Pool)
		return self._RegistredTotal
	end

	--[[
		Add object to pool
	]]
	function BasicPool.Set(self: Pool, Value: any)
		self._Pool[Value] = Value
		self._Total += 1
	end

	--[[
		Get object from pool
	]]
	function BasicPool.Get(self: Pool)
		local Pool = self._Pool
		local Value = next(Pool)
		
		if Value then
			Pool[Value] = nil
			self._Total -= 1
		end
		
		return Value
	end

	--[[
		Get (without pulling out Object from pool)
	]]
	function BasicPool.Next(self: Pool)
		local Pool = self._Pool
		local PrevNext = self._Next
		local Next
		if Pool[PrevNext] then
			Next = next(Pool, PrevNext) or next(Pool)
			self._Next = Next
			return Next
		else
			Next = next(Pool)
			self._Next = Next
		end
		
		return Next
	end

	--[[
		Get raw pool of objects
		❗ Not recommended to change anything manually ❗
	]]
	function BasicPool.GetPool(self: Pool)
		return self._Pool
	end

	--[[
		Get total objects in pool
	]]
	function BasicPool.GetTotal(self: Pool)
		return self._Total
	end

	table.freeze(BasicPool)
end

do
	function Module.New(): Pool
		return setmetatable({
			_Pool = {},
			_Total = 0,
			_Registred = {},
			_RegistredTotal = 0,
		}, BasicPool)
	end

	table.freeze(Module)
	--_G[GlobalIndex] = Module
end

return Module :: BasicPool

local Module = {}

export type Color3 = typeof(Module) & typeof(Color3)

local RNG = Random.new()
local NextNumber = RNG.NextNumber

do type([[ Copying from Color3 table ]])
	for I, V in Color3 do
		Module[I] = V
	end
end

do type([[ Own values/methods ]])
	
	--[[
		Invert Color3
	]]
	function Module.invert(Color: Color3): Color3
		return Color3.new(1 - Color.R, 1 - Color.G, 1 - Color.B)
	end
	
	--[[
		Darken Color3 by (from 0 to 1 range) amount
	]]
	function Module.darken(Color: Color3, Amount: number): Color3
		Amount = (1 - math.clamp(Amount, 0, 1))
		return Color3.new(Color.R * Amount, Color.G * Amount, Color.B * Amount)
	end
	
	--[[
		Return random color between 0 and 1
	]]
	function Module.random(Min: number?, Max: number?): Color3
		assert((not Min and not Max) or (tonumber(Min) and tonumber(Max)), `[{script}] Min and Max number expected, got Min: {Min}, Max: {Max}`)
		Min = Min or 0
		Max = Max or 1
		
		return Color3.new(NextNumber(RNG, Min, Max), NextNumber(RNG, Min, Max), NextNumber(RNG, Min, Max))
	end
	
	do
		local maxUInt32 = 4294967296
		local maxInt32 = 2147483647

		local function HashCode(String: string)
			local val = 0

			local n = #String

			for i = 1, n do
				val = (val + String:byte(i) * math.pow(31, n - i)) % maxUInt32
			end

			return math.abs(val > maxInt32 and val - maxUInt32 or val)
		end
		
		--[[
			Convert string to Color3
		]]
		function Module.fromHash(Hash: string?)
			assert(type(Hash) == `string`, `[{script}] String expected, got: {typeof(Hash)}`)
			
			local HasedNumber = HashCode(Hash)
			local R = HasedNumber % 255
			local G = (HasedNumber // 2) % 255
			local B = (HasedNumber // 3) % 255

			return Color3.fromRGB(R, G, B)
		end
	end
end

return table.freeze(Module) :: Color3

export type Prioritizer = typeof(Module)
export type PriorityData = {
	(Value: any)-> () & {[number]: any}
}

local Priorities = {} :: {[any]: PriorityData}
local PrioritizerIndexes = {
	Function = 1,
	Data = 2,
	DefaultValue = 3,
}

do
	Module.GetPriorities = function()
		return Priorities
	end

	Module.GetDefault = function(Index)
		return Priorities[Index] and Priorities[Index][PrioritizerIndexes.DefaultValue]
	end

	Module.Get = function(Index: any): PriorityData
		return Priorities[Index]
	end

	Module.Set = function(Index: any, Function: (Value: any, Priority: number | string, ...any?)-> ()?, DefaultValue: any?, ...): ()

		assert(not Function or type(Function) == `function`, `[{script}] Function expected, got {typeof(Function)}`)

		if Function then
			Priorities[Index] = {
				[PrioritizerIndexes.Function] = Function,
				[PrioritizerIndexes.Data] = {},
				[PrioritizerIndexes.DefaultValue] = DefaultValue
			}

			if DefaultValue then
				Function(DefaultValue, ...)
			end
		else
			Priorities[Index] = nil
		end

	end

	Module.SetValue = function(Index: any, Priority: number?, NewValue: any, ValueIndex: any?, ...): ()
		local ValueIndex = ValueIndex or ``
		local Is = Priorities[Index]

		if Is then
			debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}_{Index}`)
			assert(not Priority or type(Priority) == `number`, `[{script}] Number expected, got {typeof(Priority)}`)
			--local obed = tonumber(Priority) or warn(`got`, Priority)
			--print(Is[2][tonumber(Priority) or 1], Value)
			local PriorityData = {tonumber(Priority) or 1, NewValue}
			local Priorities = Is[PrioritizerIndexes.Data]
			Priorities[ValueIndex] = PriorityData
			--Is[2][tonumber(Priority) or 1] = NewValue
			--print(Is[2][tonumber(Priority) or 1], Value)

			local Priority, Value, ValueIndex

			for I, Data in Priorities do
				if not Priority or Priority < Data[1] then
					Priority, Value, ValueIndex = Data[1], Data[2], I
				end
			end

			debug.profileend()

			if Value == nil and Is[PrioritizerIndexes.DefaultValue] ~= nil then
				Is[PrioritizerIndexes.Function](Is[PrioritizerIndexes.DefaultValue], `Default`, ValueIndex, ...)
			else
				--print(NewValue, Value)
				Is[PrioritizerIndexes.Function](Value, Priority, ValueIndex, ...)
			end
		else
			warn(`[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} not found: {Index}` )
		end
	end
end

return table.freeze(Module) :: Prioritizer

do type([[ Trove ]])
	Trove.__index = Trove
	Trove.Objects = nil :: {[any]: {any}}
	Trove.UniqueID = nil :: number
	Trove.Traceback = nil :: string
	Trove.Name = nil :: any
	Trove.Stats = nil :: {
		Extended: number,
	}
	--[[
		Create new Trove that attached to previous
	]]
	function Trove.Extend(self: Trove, Name: string?): Trove
		local Stats = self.Stats
		Stats.Extended += 1
		
		return self:Add(Module.New(Name or `{self.Name}_{Stats.Extended}`))
	end
	
	--[[
		Clone a Instance.
		You can use Trove:Add(Instance.fromExisting(YourInstance)) instead
	]]
	function Trove.InstanceFrom<self, FromInstance>(self: Trove, FromInstance: FromInstance, Parent: Instance?, Name: string?): FromInstance
		local NewInstance = Instance.fromExisting(FromInstance)
		NewInstance.Parent = Parent
		NewInstance.Name = Name or NewInstance.Name
		
		return self:Add(NewInstance)
	end
	
	--[[
		Clone a Instance.
		You can use Trove:Add(YourInstance:Clone()) instead
	]]
	function Trove.InstanceClone<self, CloneInstance>(self: Trove, Instance: CloneInstance, Parent: Instance?, Name: string?): CloneInstance
		local NewInstance = Instance:Clone()
		NewInstance.Parent = Parent
		NewInstance.Name = Name or NewInstance.Name
		
		return self:Add(NewInstance)
	end

	function Trove.BindToRenderStep(self: Trove, Priority: Enum.RenderPriority | number, Function: (dt: number)->(), OnUnbind: ()->()?)
		
		local Index = math.random()
		Destroyer:BindToRenderStep(Index, Priority, Function)
		return self:Add(Index, OnUnbind, function() Destroyer:UnbindFromRenderStep(Index) end)
	end
	
	--[[
		Add object and attachment to Trove (Object destroyed == attachments destroyed)
	]]
	function Trove.Add<self, Object...>(self: Trove, Object: Object, ...): Object...
		
		local CheckExist = self.Objects[Object]
		if CheckExist then
			return warn(`[{script}] Trying to add existing Object`, Object, `Traceback:`, {debug.traceback()})
		else
			self.Objects[Object] = {...}
			return Object, ...--, function() self:Remove(Object) end
		end
	end
	
	--[[
		Remove object from Trove
	]]
	function Trove.Remove(self: Trove, Object: any, Destroy: boolean?): boolean
		local ObjectTable = self.Objects[Object]
		if ObjectTable then
			
			if Destroy then
				if type(Object) == "function" then
					Object(table.unpack(ObjectTable))
				else
					Destroyer.Destroy(Object)
					
					for _, Arg in ObjectTable do
						if type(Arg) == "function" then
							Arg()
						else
							Destroyer.Destroy(Arg)
						end
					end
				end
			end
			
			self.Objects[Object] = nil
			return true
		end
		
		return false, error(`[{script}] Object not found: {Object} {self.Name} {self.UniqueID}`)
	end
	
	--[[
		When Instance is destroyed, Trove will be also destroyed
	]]
	function Trove.AttachToInstance(self: Trove, Instance: Instance, OnDestroy: (...any)-> (), ...: any): RBXScriptConnection
		
		--print(Inst, Inst:IsDescendantOf(game))
		assert(Instance and typeof(Instance) == `Instance`, `[{script}] Instance expected, got {Instance} {typeof(Instance)}`)
			
		local All = {...}
		
		return self:Add(Instance.Destroying:Once(function()
			
			if getmetatable(self) then
				self:Destroy()	
			end
			
			if type(OnDestroy) == `function` then
				OnDestroy(table.unpack(All))
			end
		end))
	end
	
	--[[
		Clear Trove from objects
	]]
	function Trove.Clear(self: Trove, DestroyObjects: boolean?): ()
		for Object, _ in self.Objects do
			self:Remove(Object, DestroyObjects)
		end
	end
	
	--[[
		Destroy Trove and all Objects
	]]
	function Trove.Destroy(self: Trove): ()
		assert(not table.isfrozen(self), `[{script}] Unable to destroy frozen Trove`)
		self:Clear(true)
		setmetatable(self, nil)
	end
	
	table.freeze(Trove)
	
	do
		Destroyer.AddTableDestroy(`{script}`, function(Table)
			if getmetatable(Table) == Trove then
				(Table :: Trove):Destroy()
				return true
			end
		end)
	end
end

		end
	end

--[[
	Pack args in table (if not single table)
]]
function Utils.PackOnce<Any...>(...): {[number]: any}
	
	local Packed = {...}
	
	for _, Any in Packed do
		if type(Any) ~= `table` then
			return Packed
		end
	end
	
	return #Packed > 1 and Packed or ...
end

--[[
	Create Model and set Instances as childrens of Model
]]
function Utils.Group(Instances: Instance | {Instance}, Paste: boolean?): Model
	--debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)
	
	local Model = Instance.new("Model")
	local LastParent
	
	for _, Inst in Utils.PackOnce(Instances) do
		LastParent = Inst.Parent
		Inst.Parent = Model
	end
	
	Model.Parent = Paste and LastParent
	
	--debug.profileend()
	return Model
end

--[[
	Ungroup childrens of Group
]]
function Utils.Ungroup(Group: Instance | {Instance}, Into: Instance?, DestroyGroup: boolean?): ()
	for _, Group in Utils.PackOnce(Group) do
		for _, Inst in Group:GetChildren() do
			Inst.Parent = Into or Group.Parent
		end
		
		if DestroyGroup then
			Group:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function Utils.WaitForChild(Settings: FindChildSettings): Instance?
	
	local Name = Settings.Name and `{Settings.Name}` or nil
	local Where = Settings.Where
	local Timer = Settings.Timer
	local IsAPack = Settings.IsA and Utils.PackOnce(Settings.IsA) or nil :: {Instances}?
	local NoWarn = Settings.NoWarn
	
	local function CheckIsA(Any: Instance)		
		for _, IsA in IsAPack do
			if Any:IsA(IsA) then
				return Any
			end
		end
	end
	
	Utils.Assert(Where, `[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} got no Settings.Where`)

	Timer = tonumber(Timer) and Timer or 7
	local TimePassed = 0
	local Found: Instance?
	
	repeat
		if Name then
			
			Found = Where:FindFirstChild(Name, Settings.Recurcive)
			if IsAPack and Found then
				Found = CheckIsA(Found)
			end
			
		elseif IsAPack then
			
			for _, IsA in IsAPack do
				local IntermediateResult = Where:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(IsA, Settings.Recurcive)
				if IntermediateResult then
					Found = IntermediateResult
					break
				end
			end
		else
			return error(`[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} no IsA or Name`)
		end
		
		TimePassed += Timer > 0 and task.wait() or 0
		
		if script:GetAttribute(`Debug`) then
			print(Where, Name, table.unpack(IsAPack or {}))
		end
		
	until Found or TimePassed >= Timer
	
	if not Found and not NoWarn then
		warn(`[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)}`, {
			Where,
			Name, 
			table.unpack(IsAPack or {}), 
			{debug.traceback()},
		})
	end
	
	return Found
end

function Utils.FindFirstChild(Settings: FindChildSettings): Instance?
	Settings.Timer = 0
	return Utils.WaitForChild(Settings)
end

--[[
	Find or create Instance
]]
function Utils.FindOrCreate(Settings: FindChildSettings & {Properties: {[string]: any}?})
	Settings.NoWarn = true or not Services.RunService:IsStudio() -- true
	local Found = Utils.FindFirstChild(Settings) --Utils.FindFirstChild(Settings)
	
	if Found then
		return Found
	elseif Settings.Where then
		local Inst = Instance.new(Settings.IsA) :: Instance
		Inst.Name = Settings.Name or Inst.Name
		
		for I, Value in Settings.Properties or {} do
			Inst[I] = Value
		end
		
		Inst.Parent = Settings.Where
		return Inst
	end
end

--[[
	Get all descendants including self
]]
function Utils.GetEverything(Instances: Instance | {Instance}, IsA: Instances? | {Instances}?): {Instance?}
	--debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)
	
	local Everything = {}
	
	for _, Inst in Utils.PackOnce(Instances) :: {Instance} do
		local Descendants = Inst:GetDescendants()
		table.insert(Descendants, Inst)
		
		if IsA then
			local IsAGroup = Utils.PackOnce(IsA) :: {Instances}
			for _, Descendant in Descendants do
				for _, ClassName in IsAGroup do
					if Descendant:IsA(ClassName) then
						table.insert(Everything, Descendant)
						break
					end
				end
			end
		else
			for _, Descendant in Descendants do
				table.insert(Everything, Descendant)
			end
		end
	end
	
	--debug.profileend()
	return Everything
end

function Utils.IsType(Any: any, Type: Types | string): boolean
	local AnyType = string.lower(type(Any))
	local TypeType = string.lower(type(Type))
	
	if TypeType == `string` then
		local LowerStringType = string.lower(Type :: string)
		if LowerStringType ~= `string` then
			return AnyType == LowerStringType
		else
			return AnyType == TypeType
		end
	else
		return AnyType == TypeType
	end
end

		end
	else
		return AnyType == TypeType
	end
end

--[[
	Clamp CFrame in a box
]]
function Utils.CFrameClamp(Center: CFrame, To_Clamp: CFrame, Size: Vector3): CFrame
	local HalfSize = Size / 2
	local Min, Max = -HalfSize, HalfSize
	local LocalFollowPosition = Center:Inverse() * To_Clamp.Position
	local ClampedLocalPosition = Vector3.new(
		math.clamp(LocalFollowPosition.X, Min.X, Max.X),
		math.clamp(LocalFollowPosition.Y, Min.Y, Max.Y),
		math.clamp(LocalFollowPosition.Z, Min.Z, Max.Z)
	)

	return Center * CFrame.new(ClampedLocalPosition)
end

--[[
	https://devforum.roblox.com/t/getboundingbox-for-tools-and-accessories-and-possibly-more/1843092/2
]]
function Utils.CalculateBoundingBox(basisCFrame: CFrame, allParts: {BasePart}, allAttachments: {Attachment}?): (Vector3, Vector3)
	local inverseBasis = basisCFrame:Inverse()
	local xmin, xmax = math.huge, -math.huge
	local ymin, ymax = math.huge, -math.huge
	local zmin, zmax = math.huge, -math.huge

	for _, part in allParts do
		local cframe = part.CFrame
		local size = part.Size
		local sx, sy, sz = size.X, size.Y, size.Z

		-- Calculation for bounding box in the space of basisCFrame1
		local localCFrame1 = inverseBasis * cframe -- put cframe in our local basis
		local _, _, _,
		t00, t01, t02,
		t10, t11, t12,
		t20, t21, t22 = localCFrame1:components()
		local hw = 0.5 * (math.abs(sx * t00) + math.abs(sy * t01) + math.abs(sz * t02))
		local hh = 0.5 * (math.abs(sx * t10) + math.abs(sy * t11) + math.abs(sz * t12))
		local hd = 0.5 * (math.abs(sx * t20) + math.abs(sy * t21) + math.abs(sz * t22))
		local x, y, z = localCFrame1.X, localCFrame1.Y, localCFrame1.Z
		xmin = math.min(xmin, x - hw)
		xmax = math.max(xmax, x + hw)
		ymin = math.min(ymin, y - hh)
		ymax = math.max(ymax, y + hh)
		zmin = math.min(zmin, z - hd)
		zmax = math.max(zmax, z + hd)
	end
	
	for _, attachment in (allAttachments or {}) do
		local localPosition = basisCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(attachment.WorldPosition)
		local x, y, z = localPosition.X, localPosition.Y, localPosition.Z
		xmin = math.min(xmin, x)
		xmax = math.max(xmax, x)
		ymin = math.min(ymin, y)
		ymax = math.max(ymax, y)
		zmin = math.min(zmin, z)
		zmax = math.max(zmax, z)
	end

	local boundingBoxOffset = Vector3.new(
		0.5 * (xmin + xmax),
		0.5 * (ymin + ymax),
		0.5 * (zmin + zmax)
	)
	local boundingBoxSize = Vector3.new(
		xmax - xmin,
		ymax - ymin,
		zmax - zmin
	)

	return boundingBoxOffset, boundingBoxSize
end

--[[
	Instead of returning CFrame first it returns size
]]
function Utils.GetBoundingBox(Object: Instance): (Vector3, CFrame)
	--debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)
	local BaseParts = Object:QueryDescendants(`BasePart`) :: {BasePart}
	local BasisCFrame = Utils.GetPivot(Object)
	local BoundingBoxOffset, BoundingBoxSize = Utils.CalculateBoundingBox(BasisCFrame, BaseParts)
	
	--debug.profileend()
	return BoundingBoxSize, BasisCFrame + BoundingBoxOffset
end

function Utils.GetPivot(Object: Instance): CFrame?
	if Object:IsA("Model") then
		local PrimaryPart = Utils.GetPrimaryPart(Object)
		return PrimaryPart and PrimaryPart.CFrame
	elseif Object:IsA("BasePart") then
		return Object:GetPivot()
	elseif Object:IsA("Accessory") then
		local BasePart = Object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") :: BasePart
		return BasePart and BasePart:GetPivot()
	else
		warn(`[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} {Object} {typeof(Object)}`)
	end
end

function Utils.SetPivot(Object: PVInstance | Accessory, Offset: CFrame)
	if Object:IsA("BasePart") then
		Object.PivotOffset = Offset
	elseif Object:IsA("Model") then
		local PrimaryPart = Utils.GetPrimaryPart(Object) :: BasePart
		PrimaryPart.PivotOffset = Offset
	elseif Object:IsA("Accessory") then
		local Handle: BasePart? = Object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
		if Handle then
			Handle.PivotOffset = Offset
		end
	else
		warn(`[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} {Object} {typeof(Object)}`)
	end
end

function Utils.SetPivotToCenter(Object: PVInstance)
	local PositionOffset = Utils.CalculateBoundingBox(Utils.GetPivot(Object) :: CFrame, Utils.GetEverything(Object, "BasePart") :: {BasePart})
	Utils.SetPivot(Object, CFrame.new(PositionOffset))
end

function Utils.PivotTo(Object: Instance, Position: CFrame | Vector3): boolean?
	local PivotCFrame = Utils.IsTypeOf(Position, "Vector3") and CFrame.new(Position) or Position :: CFrame

	if Object:IsA("Model") or Object:IsA("BasePart") then
		Object:PivotTo(PivotCFrame)
		return true
	elseif Object:IsA("Accessory") then
		local Handle: BasePart? = Object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
		if Handle then
			Handle:PivotTo(PivotCFrame)
			return true
		end
	else
		return warn(`[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} {Object} {typeof(Object)}`)
	end
	
	return false
end

--[[
	Fit object in Camera view
]]
function Utils.GetFitDistance(Inst: Instance, Camera: Camera, GuiObject: GuiObject?)
	local Object_Size = Utils.GetBoundingBox(Inst)
	local GuiObject_Size = GuiObject and GuiObject.AbsoluteSize or workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize

	-- clamped b/c we only want to scale the xfov2 if width < height
	-- otherwise if width > height then xfov2 == yfov2
	local wh = math.min(1, GuiObject_Size.X / GuiObject_Size.Y)
	local yfov2 = math.rad(Camera.FieldOfView / 2)
	local xfov2 = math.atan(math.tan(yfov2) * wh)
	local Radius = Object_Size.Magnitude / 2

	return Radius / math.sin(xfov2)
end

--[[
	Convert tables to string
]]
function Utils.ToString(Table: any, Depth: number?)
	--debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)
	
	if type(Table) ~= 'table' then
		return `{typeof(Table)} {Table}` --tostring(Table)
	elseif not next(Table) then
		return '{}'
	end

	local Spaces = 4
	local Depth = Depth or 1
	local UseSemiColon = false

	local Space = (" "):rep(Depth * Spaces)
	local Sep = UseSemiColon and ";" or ","
	local ConcatenationBuilder = {"{"}

	for k, x in next, Table do
		table.insert(ConcatenationBuilder, 
			("\n%s[%s] = %s%s"):format(Space, type(k)=='number' and `{k}` or ('"%s"'):format(`{k}`), Utils.ToString(x, Depth + 1), Sep))
	end

	local ConcatedTable = table.concat(ConcatenationBuilder)
	
	--debug.profileend()
	return ("%s\n%s}"):format(ConcatedTable:sub(1, -2), Space:sub(1, - Spaces - 1))
end

export type table = typeof(Module) & typeof(table)

do type([[ Copying from table table ]])

		Module[I] = V
	end
end

do
	
	do
		local CloneMethods = {
			table = function(Table) return Module.deepClone(Table) end,
			SharedTable = function(Table) return SharedTable.clone(Table, true) end,
		}
		
		--[[
			Clone table with every subtables
		]]
		function Module.deepClone<Table>(Table: Table): Table
			local clone = table.clone(Table) 

			-- Loop through the original table to check for table values
			-- If a table is found as a value, deep clone it to the key (index)
			for I, Value in Table do
				
				
				local TypeOf = typeof(Value)
				
				if CloneMethods[TypeOf] then
					clone[I] = CloneMethods[TypeOf](Value)
				else
					clone[I] = Value
				end
			end

			-- Return the finalized copy of the deep cloned table
			return clone
		end
	end
	
	--[[
		Freeze table and every subtables
	]]
	function Module.deepFreeze<Table>(Table: Table): Table
		table.freeze(Table)

		-- Check each key of the table and freeze it if it's a table
		for _, value in Table do
			-- Make sure the value isn't frozen; if it already is, an error will occur
			if type(value) == "table" and table.isfrozen(value) == false then
				Module.deepFreeze(value)
			end
		end
		
		return Table
	end
	
	--[[
		Merge 2 tables values into 1
		(Will return Table2)
	]]
	function Module.merge<Table1, Table2>(Table1, Table2, DeepClone: boolean?): Table1 & Table2
		if DeepClone then
			Table1, Table2 = Module.deepClone(Table1), Module.deepClone(Table2)
		end
		
		for I, Value in Table1 do
			Table2[I] = Value
		end
		
		return Table2
	end
	
	--[[
		You this if you want to send RaycastResult from (Client to Server) or (Server to Client)
	]]
	function Module.raycastresultClone(RaycastResult: RaycastResult): RaycastResult
		return {
			Instance = RaycastResult.Instance,
			Position = RaycastResult.Position,
			Normal = RaycastResult.Normal,
			Distance = RaycastResult.Distance,
			Material = RaycastResult.Material,
		}
	end
	
	--[[
		Check if table is empty
	]]
	function Module.isEmpty(Table: {[any]: any}): boolean
		return next(Table) == nil
	end
	
	--[[
		Get length of table
	]]
	function Module.length(Table: {[any]: any}): number
		local Number = 0
		for _, _ in Table do
			Number += 1
		end
		return Number
	end
end

return table.freeze(Module) :: table

local NextNumber = RNG.NextNumber

--[[
	Return X, Y, Z vector numbers
]]
function Module.unpack(Vec: vector | Vector3 | Vector2): (number, number, number?)
	local Type = typeof(Vec)
	
	assert(Type == `Vector3` or Type == `Vector2`, `[{script}] Vector expected, got {Type}`)
	
	if Type == `Vector3` then
		return Vec.x, Vec.Y, Vec.Z
	else
		return Vec.X, Vec.Y
	end
end

--[[
	Create new vector with random numbers
]]
function Module.random(Min: number?, Max: number?): vector
	assert((not Min and not Max) or (tonumber(Min) and tonumber(Max)), `[{script}] Min and Max number expected, got Min: {Min}, Max: {Max}`)
	Min = Min or 0
	Max = Max or 1
	
	return vector.create(NextNumber(RNG, Min, Max), NextNumber(RNG, Min, Max), NextNumber(RNG, Min, Max))
end

--[[
	math.round() X, Y, Z numbers
]]
function Module.round(Vec: vector): vector
	
	local Type = typeof(Vec)

	assert(Type == `Vector3` or Type == `Vector2`, `[{script}] Vector expected, got {Type}`)
	
	if Type == `Vector3` then
		return vector.create(math.round(Vec.x), math.round(Vec.y), math.round(Vec.z))
	else
		return vector.create(math.round(Vec.z), math.round(Vec.y))
	end
end

		end
	end

	if script ~= LatestVersionModule then

		if _G[GlobalIndex] then
			return _G[GlobalIndex] :: SetParallel
		end

		return require(LatestVersionModule) :: SetParallel
	else
		_G[GlobalIndex] = Module
	end
end

	local Connect = BindableEventExample.Event:ConnectParallel(tick)
	Connect:Disconnect()
end)

local Names = table.freeze{
	Bindable = `{script}_Bindable_{Service_Run:IsClient() and `Client` or `Server`}`,
	ObjectValue = `SetParallelObjectValue`,
	GetAllTopics = `GetAllTopics`,
}

local function GetTableLenght(Table): number
	local Lenght = 0
	for _ in Table do
		Lenght += 1
	end
	return Lenght
end

local Manager = {} 
export type Manager = typeof(Manager)
do
	
	if not IsVM then
		Manager.__index = Manager
		Manager._Actors = nil :: {[number]: Actor}
		Manager._Container = nil :: Instance
		Manager._BaseScript = nil :: BaseScript
		Manager._NextNumber = nil :: number
		Manager._Topics = nil :: {[string]: boolean}
		Manager._Working = nil :: {[any]: boolean?}
		Manager._InitTimeout = nil :: number
		Manager._ActorsCount = nil :: number
		Manager.OnActorsAmountChange = nil :: (NewAmount: number, OldAmount: number)-> ()?
		
		do type([[ Sync ]])
			
			function Manager.SetWork(self: Manager, Topic: string, ...:any?): (...any) -- Говорим о том что работа создаётся
				local ThisThread = coroutine.running()
				
				self:SetWorkAsync(Topic, function(...)
					task.defer(ThisThread, ...)
				end, ...)
				
				return coroutine.yield()
			end
			
			function Manager.SetWorks(self: Manager, Total: number, Topic: string, ...:any): ({[number]: any?})
				local ThisThread = coroutine.running()

				self:SetWorksAsync(Total, Topic, function(...)
					task.defer(ThisThread, ...)
				end, ...)

				return coroutine.yield()
			end
			
			function Manager.SetAllWork(self: Manager, Topic: string, ...:any): ({[number]: any?})
				local ThisThread = coroutine.running()

				self:SetAllWorkAsync(Topic, function(...)
					task.defer(ThisThread, ...)
				end, ...)

				return coroutine.yield()
			end
			
			function Manager.SetWorkFromTo(self: Manager, Total: number, Topic: string, StartIndex: number, EndIndex: number, ...:any?)
				local ThisThread = coroutine.running()

				self:SetWorkFromToAsync(Topic, function(...)
					task.defer(ThisThread, ...)
				end, StartIndex, EndIndex, ...)

				return coroutine.yield()
			end
		end
		
		do type([[ Async ]])
			
			function Manager.WorkAsync(self: Manager, Actor: Actor, Topic: string, Index: any, OnComplete: (...any)-> ()?, ...:any?): (...any)
				
				debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)
				
				if not self._Topics[Topic] then
					return warn(`[{script}] {debug.info(2, `n`)}, no actors found`)
				end
				
				local Unique
				repeat
					Unique = `{Topic}_{Index}_{math.random()}`
				until not self._Working[Unique]

				self._Bindable:Once(Unique, function(...)
					self._Working[Unique] = nil

					if type(OnComplete) == `function` then
						task.defer(OnComplete, ...)
					end
				end)

				Actor:SendMessage(Topic, Unique, ...)
				
				debug.profileend()
				
				return Unique
			end
			
			function Manager.SetWorkAsync(self: Manager, Topic: string, OnComplete: (...any)-> ()?, ...:any?) -- Говорим о том что работа создаётся
				
				local Actor, NextNumber = self:GetNextActor()

				if Actor then
					return self:WorkAsync(Actor, Topic, NextNumber, OnComplete, ...)
				else
					return warn(`[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)}, no actors found`)
				end
			end
			
			--[[Invoke n-time a]]
			function Manager.SetWorksAsync(self: Manager, Total: number, Topic: string, OnComplete: (...any)-> ()?, ...:any?) -- Говорим о том что работа создаётся
				local Results = {}
				local Completed = 0
				
				if Total ~= Total or Total < 1 then
					return Results
				end
				
				for I = 1, Total do
					self:SetWorkAsync(Topic, function(Result)
						Completed += 1
						Results[I] = {Result}
						
						if Completed >= Total then
							task.defer(OnComplete, Results)
						end
					end)
				end
			end
			
			function Manager.SetWorkFromToAsync(self: Manager, Topic: string, OnComplete: (...any)-> ()?, StartIndex: number, EndIndex: number, ...:any?)
				assert(tonumber(StartIndex), `[{script}] StartIndex is not a number: {StartIndex}`)
				assert(tonumber(EndIndex), `[{script}] EndIndex is not a number: {EndIndex}`)
				assert(EndIndex < StartIndex, `[{script}] EndIndex is smaller than StartIndex`)
				
				local Results = {}
				local Completed = 0
				local Iteration = 0
				local Total = EndIndex - StartIndex
				
				for I, Actor in self._Actors do
					Iteration += 1
					
					if Iteration >= StartIndex and Iteration <= EndIndex then
						
						local MyIteration = Iteration
						
						self:WorkAsync(Actor, Topic, I, function(Result)
							Completed += 1
							Results[MyIteration] = {Result}

							if OnComplete and Completed >= Total then
								task.defer(OnComplete, Results)
							end
						end, ...)
					end
				end
			end
			
			--[[Inove all actors]]
			function Manager.SetAllWorkAsync(self: Manager, Topic: string, OnComplete: (...any)-> ()?, ...:any?)
				
				local Results = {}
				local Iteration = 0
				local Completed = 0
				local Total = self:GetActorsCount() -- #self._Actors
				
				for I, Actor in self._Actors do
					Iteration += 1
					local MyIteration = Iteration
					self:WorkAsync(Actor, Topic, I, function(Result)
						Completed += 1
						Results[MyIteration] = {Result}

						if OnComplete and Completed >= Total then
							task.defer(OnComplete, Results)
						end
					end, ...)
				end
			end
		end
		
		do type([[ Other ]])
			function Manager.GetActors(self: Manager, RespectArray: boolean?)
				if RespectArray then
					local Iteration = 0
					local Array = {}
					
					for _, Actor in self._Actors do
						Iteration += 1
						Array[Iteration] = Actor
					end
					
					return Array
				else
					return table.clone(self._Actors)
				end
			end
			
			function Manager.GetActorsCount(self: Manager): number
				return GetTableLenght(self._Actors)
			end
			
			function Manager.SetActorsCount(self: Manager, Count: number): ()
				local ThisThread = coroutine.running()
				local Actors = self._Actors
				local CurrentActorsCount = GetTableLenght(Actors)
				local ReturnedResult = 0

				local function ScriptTimeout(Actor: Actor, BaseScript: BasePart)
					if Actor:IsDescendantOf(game) then
						warn(`[{script}] Script init timeout: {BaseScript}`)
					end
					--Actor:Destroy()
					self._Bindable:Disconnect(Actor)
					self._Bindable:Fires(ThisThread)
				end

				if Count >= 1 then

					if Count > CurrentActorsCount then -- Add

						local Difference = Count - CurrentActorsCount

						self._Bindable:Connect(`{ThisThread}`, function()
							ReturnedResult += 1
							--print(Difference)
							if ReturnedResult >= Difference then
								self._Bindable:Disconnect(`{ThisThread}`)
								task.defer(ThisThread)
							end
						end)

						for I = CurrentActorsCount + 1, Count do
							local Actor = Instance.new(`Actor`)
							local BaseScript = self._BaseScript:Clone()-- Instance.fromExisting(self._BaseScript)
							local ThreadDelay = task.delay(self._InitTimeout, ScriptTimeout, Actor, BaseScript)
							
							BaseScript.Destroying:Connect(function()
								
								if Actors[Actor] then
									Actors[Actor] = nil
									self._Bindable:Disconnect(Actor)
									Actor:Destroy()
									local OldActorsAmount = self:GetActorsCount() -- GetTableLenght(Actors)
									local NewActorsAmount = OldActorsAmount - 1
									self._ActorsCount = NewActorsAmount
									
									if type(self.OnActorsAmountChange) == `function` then
										self.OnActorsAmountChange(NewActorsAmount, OldActorsAmount, true)
									end
								end
							end)
							
							self._Bindable:Once(Actor, function(Topics: {[string]: boolean})
								local OldActorsAmount = self:GetActorsCount()
								self._Topics = self._Topics or table.freeze(Topics)
								task.cancel(ThreadDelay)
								self._Actors[Actor] = Actor
								self._Bindable:Fires(`{ThisThread}`)
								local NewActorsAmount = OldActorsAmount + 1
								self._ActorsCount = NewActorsAmount
								
								if type(self.OnActorsAmountChange) == `function` then
									self.OnActorsAmountChange(NewActorsAmount, OldActorsAmount, false)
								end
							end)

							Actor.Parent = self._Container
							BaseScript.Parent = Actor
							BaseScript.Enabled = true
						end
						
						return coroutine.yield()

					elseif Count < CurrentActorsCount then -- Remove

						for I = CurrentActorsCount, Count + 1, -1 do
							local Actor = next(Actors) --Actors[I]
							if Actor then
								Actors[Actor] = nil
								self._Bindable:Disconnect(Actor)
								Actor:Destroy()
							end
						end
						
						self._ActorsCount = Count
						
						if type(self.OnActorsAmountChange) == `function` then
							task.defer(self.OnActorsAmountChange, Count, CurrentActorsCount, true)
						end
					end
				else
					warn(`[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} a number equal to 1 or greater was expected, got: {Count}`)
				end
			end

			function Manager.GetNextActor(self: Manager): (Actor, number)
				
				local NowTick = tick()
				
				--debug.profilebegin(`{script}_{debug.info(1, `n`)}`)
				
				local Actors = self._Actors
				local NextNumber = next(Actors, self._NextNumber) or next(Actors) --math.max(1, (self._NextNumber + 1) % (#Actors + 1))
				self._NextNumber = NextNumber
				
				--debug.profileend()
				
				--local Passed = tick() - NowTick
				
				--if Passed > 0.0005 then
				--	warn(Passed)
				--end
				
				return Actors[NextNumber], NextNumber
			end
			
			function Manager.Destroy(self: Manager)
				
				for I, Actor in self._Actors do
					self._Actors[I] = nil
					Actor:Destroy()
				end
				
				setmetatable(self, nil)
			end
		end
			
		table.freeze(Manager)
		
	end
	
	--[[
		Create manager for VM scripts
	]]
	function Module.CreateManager(Container: Instance, BaseScript: BaseScript?): Manager
		
		assert(not IsVM, `[{script}] Trying to create Serial Manager in VM`)
		
		if BaseScript then
			
			assert(typeof(BaseScript) == `Instance` and (BaseScript:IsA(`LocalScript`) or BaseScript:IsA(`Script`)), `[{script}] LocalScript or Script expected, got {typeof(BaseScript) == `Instance` and BaseScript.ClassName or typeof(BaseScript)}`)
			
			if Service_Run:IsClient() then
				if BaseScript.ClassName == `Script` then
					--print(BaseScript, BaseScript.RunContext)
					assert(BaseScript.RunContext == Enum.RunContext.Client, `[{script}] Trying to parallel server script: {BaseScript}`)
				elseif BaseScript:IsA(`LocalScript`) then
					assert(Container:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.PlayerGui)
						or 
						Container:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts)
						or
						Container:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Character)
						or
						Container:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Backpack)
						or
						Container:IsDescendantOf(Service_ReplicatedFirst),
						`[{script}] LocalScript undable to excecute in current data model. Docs: https://create.roblox.com/docs/projects/data-model#client`
					)
				end
			else
				-- Server
			end
		else
			if Service_Run:IsClient() then
				BaseScript = WorkerScripts:WaitForChild(`ActorClient`):WaitForChild(`Client`)
			else
				BaseScript = WorkerScripts:WaitForChild(`ActorServer`):WaitForChild(`Server`)
			end
		end
		
		if Container then
			assert(typeof(Container) == `Instance`, `[{script}] Instance expected, got {typeof(Container)}`)
			assert(Container:IsDescendantOf(game), `[{script}] Container is not descendant of game`)
		end
		
		local BindableIndex = require(script:WaitForChild(`BindableIndex`))
		local Bindable = BindableIndex.New()
		
		do
			local BindableInstance = Bindable:GetInstance()
			BindableInstance.Name = Names.Bindable
			BindableInstance.Parent = Container
		end
		
		do
			if not Container:FindFirstChild(Names.ObjectValue) then
				local ObjectValue = Instance.new(`ObjectValue`)
				ObjectValue.Name = Names.ObjectValue
				ObjectValue.Value = script
				ObjectValue.Parent = Container
			end
		end
		
		local self = setmetatable({}, Manager) :: Manager
		self._Container = Container
		self._BaseScript = BaseScript
		self._Bindable = Bindable
		self._NextNumber = nil
		self._InitTimeout = 3
		self._Working = {}
		self._Actors = {}
		self._ActorsCount = 0
		self:SetActorsCount(1) -- Needed to get script's topics
		
		return self
	end
end

	--[[

		Create parallel worker
	]]
	function Module.CreateWorker(Actor: Actor, Init: (Worker: Worker)-> (), ListOfInstancesForObjectValues: {Instance}?)
		assert(IsVM, `[{script}] Trying to create worker that not under Actor`)
		assert(typeof(Actor) == `Instance` and Actor:IsA(`Actor`), `[{script}] Actor expected, got: {Actor}`)
		--assert(type(Init) == `function`, `[{script}] function expected, got {type(Init)}`)
		local BindableInstance = Actor.Parent:WaitForChild(Names.Bindable) :: BindableEvent
		local self = setmetatable({}, Worker) :: Worker
		self._Actor = Actor
		self._Topics = {}
		self._Bindable = BindableInstance
		
		--if Init then
			assert(type(Init) == `function`, `[{script}] function expected, got {typeof(Init)}`)
			Init(self)
		--end
		
		table.freeze(self._Topics)
		BindableInstance:Fire(Actor, self._Topics)
		coroutine.yield() -- Disable code excecution after init
	end
	
	function Module.DefaultInit(self)
		do

			for _, ModuleScript in Service_Collection:GetTagged(Module.ParallelFunctionsModuleTag) do

				if ModuleScript:IsA(`ModuleScript`) then

					local Module = require(ModuleScript)
					if type(Module) == `table` then
						for Topic, Function in Module do
							if type(Function) == `function` then					
								self:BindToMessage(true, Topic, Function)
							else
								warn(`[{script}] Module: {ModuleScript}, Index: {Topic}, function expected, got: {typeof(Function)}`)
							end
						end
					else
						warn(`[{script}] table expected, got: {typeof(Module)}`)
					end
				else
					warn(`[{script}] ModuleScript expected, got: {ModuleScript.ClassName}`)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Generic Roblox DataType inverse lerp function
function InverseRobloxLerp(V0, V1, Result)
	-- For types that support :Lerp(), we need to handle each case individually
	-- This will be implemented per type below
	error("InverseLerp not implemented for this type")
end

function InverseLerp(Start, Finish, Result)
	if Finish == Start then
		return 0
	end
	return (Result - Start) / (Finish - Start)
end

return {
	-- Inverse lerp functions
	boolean = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- For boolean, alpha is either 0 or 1 based on which value matches
		
		if Result == V0 then
			return 0
		elseif Result == V1 then
			return 1
		else
			-- Invalid case, return midpoint
			return 0.5
		end
	end,

	number = InverseLerp,

	string = function(Value1, Value2, Result)
		-- String lerping is complex, so we'll approximate by comparing lengths
		-- and character codes
		local Length1 = #Value1
		local Length2 = #Value2
		local ResultLength = #Result

		-- Calculate length-based alpha
		local lengthAlpha
		if Length2 == Length1 then
			lengthAlpha = 0.5
		else
			lengthAlpha = (ResultLength - Length1) / (Length2 - Length1)
		end

		-- Calculate character code-based alpha (average of all characters)
		local charAlphas = {}
		local maxLength = math.max(Length1, Length2, ResultLength)

		for i = 1, maxLength do
			local char1 = string.sub(Value1, i, i) or ""
			local char2 = string.sub(Value2, i, i) or ""
			local resultChar = string.sub(Result, i, i) or ""

			if #char1 > 0 and #char2 > 0 and #resultChar > 0 then
				local code1 = char1:byte()
				local code2 = char2:byte()
				local resultCode = resultChar:byte()

				if code2 ~= code1 then
					table.insert(charAlphas, (resultCode - code1) / (code2 - code1))
				end
			end
		end

		if #charAlphas > 0 then
			local sum = 0
			for _, alpha in ipairs(charAlphas) do
				sum = sum + alpha
			end
			return sum / #charAlphas
		else
			return lengthAlpha
		end
	end,

	CFrame = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- For CFrame, we can't easily invert the lerp, so we'll approximate
		-- by comparing positions
		local pos0 = V0.Position
		local pos1 = V1.Position
		local resultPos = Result.Position

		-- Calculate alpha based on position interpolation
		local xAlpha = InverseLerp(pos0.X, pos1.X, resultPos.X)
		local yAlpha = InverseLerp(pos0.Y, pos1.Y, resultPos.Y)
		local zAlpha = InverseLerp(pos0.Z, pos1.Z, resultPos.Z)

		return (xAlpha + yAlpha + zAlpha) / 3
	end,

	Color3 = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Calculate alpha for each color channel and average
		local rAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.R, V1.R, Result.R)
		local gAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.G, V1.G, Result.G)
		local bAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.B, V1.B, Result.B)

		return (rAlpha + gAlpha + bAlpha) / 3
	end,

	NumberRange = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Calculate alpha for min and max separately
		local minAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Min, V1.Min, Result.Min)
		local maxAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Max, V1.Max, Result.Max)

		return (minAlpha + maxAlpha) / 2
	end,

	NumberSequenceKeypoint = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Calculate alpha for time, value, and envelope
		local timeAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Time, V1.Time, Result.Time)
		local valueAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Value, V1.Value, Result.Value)
		local envelopeAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Envelope, V1.Envelope, Result.Envelope)

		return (timeAlpha + valueAlpha + envelopeAlpha) / 3
	end,

	PhysicalProperties = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Calculate alpha for each property
		local densityAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Density, V1.Density, Result.Density)
		local elasticityAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Elasticity, V1.Elasticity, Result.Elasticity)
		local elasticityWeightAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.ElasticityWeight, V1.ElasticityWeight, Result.ElasticityWeight)
		local frictionAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Friction, V1.Friction, Result.Friction)
		local frictionWeightAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.FrictionWeight, V1.FrictionWeight, Result.FrictionWeight)

		return (densityAlpha + elasticityAlpha + elasticityWeightAlpha + frictionAlpha + frictionWeightAlpha) / 5
	end,

	Ray = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Calculate alpha for origin and direction separately
		local originXAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Origin.X, V1.Origin.X, Result.Origin.X)
		local originYAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Origin.Y, V1.Origin.Y, Result.Origin.Y)
		local originZAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Origin.Z, V1.Origin.Z, Result.Origin.Z)

		local dirXAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Direction.X, V1.Direction.X, Result.Direction.X)
		local dirYAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Direction.Y, V1.Direction.Y, Result.Direction.Y)
		local dirZAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Direction.Z, V1.Direction.Z, Result.Direction.Z)

		local originAlpha = (originXAlpha + originYAlpha + originZAlpha) / 3
		local dirAlpha = (dirXAlpha + dirYAlpha + dirZAlpha) / 3

		return (originAlpha + dirAlpha) / 2
	end,

	UDim = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Calculate alpha for scale and offset
		local scaleAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Scale, V1.Scale, Result.Scale)
		local offsetAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Offset, V1.Offset, Result.Offset)

		return (scaleAlpha + offsetAlpha) / 2
	end,

	UDim2 = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Calculate alpha for X and Y components
		local xScaleAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.X.Scale, V1.X.Scale, Result.X.Scale)
		local xOffsetAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.X.Offset, V1.X.Offset, Result.X.Offset)
		local yScaleAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Y.Scale, V1.Y.Scale, Result.Y.Scale)
		local yOffsetAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Y.Offset, V1.Y.Offset, Result.Y.Offset)

		local xAlpha = (xScaleAlpha + xOffsetAlpha) / 2
		local yAlpha = (yScaleAlpha + yOffsetAlpha) / 2

		return (xAlpha + yAlpha) / 2
	end,

	Vector2 = function(V0, V1, Result)
		local xAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.X, V1.X, Result.X)
		local yAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Y, V1.Y, Result.Y)
		return (xAlpha + yAlpha) / 2
	end,

	Vector3 = function(V0, V1, Result)
		local xAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.X, V1.X, Result.X)
		local yAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Y, V1.Y, Result.Y)
		local zAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Z, V1.Z, Result.Z)
		return (xAlpha + yAlpha + zAlpha) / 3
	end,

	Rect = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Calculate alpha for min and max coordinates
		local minXAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Min.X, V1.Min.X, Result.Min.X)
		local minYAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Min.Y, V1.Min.Y, Result.Min.Y)

function IsSameTypes(...)
	local LastType
	
	for _, Value in {...} do
		if not LastType then
			LastType = typeof(Value)
		else
			assert(LastType == typeof(Value), `[{script}] {debug.info(2, `n`)} same types expected, got {typeof(Value)}`)
		end
	end
	
	return LastType
end

function Module.GetLerp<Value1, Value2>(Value1: Value1, Value2: Value2): (Alpha: number)-> Value1 & Value2 
	local Type = IsSameTypes(Value1, Value2)
	assert(Lerp[Type], `[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} type {Type} not found`)
	return function(Alpha: number)
		return Lerp[Type](Value1, Value2, Alpha)
	end
end

function Module.Lerp<Value1, Value2>(Value1: Value1, Value2: Value2, Alpha: number): Value1 & Value2
	local Type = IsSameTypes(Value1, Value2)
	assert(Lerp[Type], `[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} type {Type} not found`)
	return Lerp[Type](Value1, Value2, Alpha)
end

function Module.Alpha<Value1, Value2, Value3>(Value1: Value1, Value2: Value2, Value3: Value3): number
	local Type = IsSameTypes(Value1, Value2, Value3)
	return Alpha[Type](Value1, Value2, Value3)
end

local Module = {}
local Promise = {}

export type PromiseStart = typeof(Module)
export type Promise = typeof(Promise)

local ErrorHandler = require(script:WaitForChild(`ErrorHandler`))
local EmptyTable = table.freeze{}

type([[ PromiseStart ]]) do
	do
		Module.PromiseStatuses = {
			Started = `Started`,
			Cancelled = `Cancelled`,
			Resolved = `Resolved`,
			Rejected = `Rejected`,
		}
	end
	
	--[[
		Create promise
	]]
	function Module.New(Function: (Promise: Promise)-> ()?): Promise
		Function = type(Function) == `function` and Function or tick
		local self = setmetatable({
			Traceback = debug.traceback(nil, 2),
			Status = Module.PromiseStatuses.Started,
			Success = false,
			Thread = nil, -- task.defer(Function, self)
			Result = nil, -- Тут хранится результат
			Function = Function,
			OnResult = {},
		}, Promise)
		
		self.Thread = task.defer(Module.NewPromiseThread, self)
		
		return self
	end
	
	--[[
		Create promise that wait until all promises is completed successuful
	]]
	function Module.All(Promises: {Promise}): Promise
		assert(type(Promise) == `table`, `[{script}] table expected, got: {typeof(Promises)}`)
		
		return Module.New(function(self)
			for _, Promise in Promises do
				local Success, Result = Promise:Await()
				if not Success then
					self:Reject(Result)
				end
			end
			
			self:Resolve()
		end)
	end
	
	--[[
		Check if its Promise
	]]
	function Module.Is(IsPromise: Promise?): boolean
		return getmetatable(IsPromise) == Promise
	end
	
	--[[
		Create a thread with promise function
	]]
	function Module.NewPromiseThread(Promise: Promise)
		--Excecuting function and catching error
		local Success, Result = xpcall(Promise.Function, Module.NewErrorHandler(Promise.Traceback), Promise)

		if not Success then
			Promise:Reject(Result)
		end
	end
	
	function Module.NewErrorHandler(Traceback: string)
			assert(type(Traceback) == `string`, `Traceback ~= string: {typeof(Traceback)}`)

			return function(ErrorObject: ErrorHandler.Error)
				--print(ErrorObject)
				-- If the error object is already a table, forward it directly.
				-- Should we extend the error here and add our own trace?

				--if type(ErrorObject) == "table" then return ErrorObject end

				return ErrorHandler.New({
					Error = ErrorObject,
					Kind = ErrorHandler.Kind.ExecutionError,
					Trace = debug.traceback(`{ErrorObject}`, 2),
					Context = `Promise created at:\n\n {Traceback}`,
				})
			end
		end
	
	table.freeze(Module)
end

type([[ Promise ]]) do
	
	do
		Promise.__index = Promise
		Promise.OnResult = nil :: {[any]: (...any)->()}
		Promise.Status = nil :: string
		Promise.Result = nil :: {any}
		Promise.Traceback = nil :: string
		Promise.Success = nil :: boolean
		Promise.Function = nil :: ()-> ()
		Promise.Thread = nil :: thread
		Promise.RetryHanler = nil :: ()-> ()
	end
	
	type([[ Public ]]) do
		--[[
			Wait for Promise to end
		]]
		function Promise.Await(self: Promise, Unpack: boolean?): (...any)
			if self.Status == Module.PromiseStatuses.Started then
				local ThisThread = coroutine.running()
				
				table.insert(self.OnResult, function(Status: string)
					task.defer(ThisThread)
				end)

				coroutine.yield()
			end
			
			return self.Success, Unpack and table.unpack((self.Result or EmptyTable)) or self.Result
		end
		
		--[[
			Excecute function on Success/Fail
		]]
		function Promise.AndThen(self: Promise, OnSuccess: (...any)-> ()?, OnFail: (Error: string)-> ()?)
			task.defer(function()
				local Success, Result = self:Await(false)
				--print(Result)
				if Success and OnSuccess then
					OnSuccess(table.unpack((Result or EmptyTable)) or Result)
				elseif not Success and OnFail then
					OnFail(table.unpack((Result or EmptyTable)) or Result)
				end
			end)

			return self
		end
		
		function Promise.Catch(self: Promise, Handler: (Error: string)-> ())
			return self:AndThen(nil, Handler)
		end
		
		function Promise.Resolve(self: Promise, ...)
			self.Result = ... and {...}
			self:_Finalize(Module.PromiseStatuses.Resolved)
		end
		
		function Promise.Reject(self: Promise, ErrorResult: string)
			self.Result = {ErrorResult}
			self:_Finalize(Module.PromiseStatuses.Rejected)
		end
		
		function Promise.Timeout(self: Promise, Time: number)
			local Traceback = debug.traceback(nil, 2)
			
			task.delay(Time, function()
				if not self.Success then
					self:Reject(ErrorHandler.New({
						Kind = ErrorHandler.Kind.TimedOut,
						Error = "Timed out",
						Context = string.format(
							"Timeout of %d seconds exceeded.\n:Timeout() called at:\n\n%s",
							Time,
							Traceback
						),
					}))
				end
			end)

			return self
		end
		
		function Promise.Retry(self: Promise, Times: number)
			
			local Tries = 0
			
			self.RetryHandler = function()
				if Tries >= Times then
					return true
				else
					Tries += 1
					return Module.NewPromiseThread(self)
				end
			end

			return self
		end
	end
	
	type([[ Private ]]) do
		function Promise._Finalize(self: Promise, Status: string)

			if self.Status == Module.PromiseStatuses.Rejected then
				if self.RetryHandler and not self.RetryHandler() then -- Перезапускаем всё заного
					return
				end
			end
			
			if self.Status == Module.PromiseStatuses.Started then
				if coroutine.running() ~= self.Thread then
					coroutine.close(self.Thread)
				end
				
				self.Status = Status
				self.Success = self.Status == Module.PromiseStatuses.Resolved
				
				local OnResult = self.OnResult
				for I, Function in OnResult do
					task.defer(Function, self.Status)
					OnResult[I] = nil
				end
			else
				warn(`[{script}] Trying to update Status on completed Promise \n\n {debug.traceback(nil, 2)}`)
			end
		end
	end	
end

return Module

function InverseLerp(Start, Finish, Result)
	if Finish == Start then
		return 0
	end
	return (Result - Start) / (Finish - Start)

		if Length2 == Length1 then

		else

		end

		local maxLength = math.max(Length1, Length2, ResultLength)

		local frictionWeightAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.FrictionWeight, V1.FrictionWeight, Result.FrictionWeight)

		return (densityAlpha + elasticityAlpha + elasticityWeightAlpha + frictionAlpha + frictionWeightAlpha) / 5
	end,

	Ray = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Calculate alpha for origin and direction separately
		local originXAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Origin.X, V1.Origin.X, Result.Origin.X)
		local originYAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Origin.Y, V1.Origin.Y, Result.Origin.Y)
		local originZAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Origin.Z, V1.Origin.Z, Result.Origin.Z)

		local dirXAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Direction.X, V1.Direction.X, Result.Direction.X)
		local dirYAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Direction.Y, V1.Direction.Y, Result.Direction.Y)
		local dirZAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Direction.Z, V1.Direction.Z, Result.Direction.Z)

		local originAlpha = (originXAlpha + originYAlpha + originZAlpha) / 3
		local dirAlpha = (dirXAlpha + dirYAlpha + dirZAlpha) / 3

		return (originAlpha + dirAlpha) / 2
	end,

	UDim = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Calculate alpha for scale and offset
		local scaleAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Scale, V1.Scale, Result.Scale)
		local offsetAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Offset, V1.Offset, Result.Offset)

		return (scaleAlpha + offsetAlpha) / 2
	end,

	UDim2 = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Calculate alpha for X and Y components
		local xScaleAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.X.Scale, V1.X.Scale, Result.X.Scale)
		local xOffsetAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.X.Offset, V1.X.Offset, Result.X.Offset)
		local yScaleAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Y.Scale, V1.Y.Scale, Result.Y.Scale)
		local yOffsetAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Y.Offset, V1.Y.Offset, Result.Y.Offset)

		local xAlpha = (xScaleAlpha + xOffsetAlpha) / 2
		local yAlpha = (yScaleAlpha + yOffsetAlpha) / 2

		return (xAlpha + yAlpha) / 2
	end,

	Vector2 = function(V0, V1, Result)
		local xAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.X, V1.X, Result.X)
		local yAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Y, V1.Y, Result.Y)
		return (xAlpha + yAlpha) / 2
	end,

	Vector3 = function(V0, V1, Result)
		local xAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.X, V1.X, Result.X)
		local yAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Y, V1.Y, Result.Y)
		local zAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Z, V1.Z, Result.Z)
		return (xAlpha + yAlpha + zAlpha) / 3
	end,

	Rect = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Calculate alpha for min and max coordinates
		local minXAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Min.X, V1.Min.X, Result.Min.X)
		local minYAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Min.Y, V1.Min.Y, Result.Min.Y)
		local maxXAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Max.X, V1.Max.X, Result.Max.X)
		local maxYAlpha = InverseLerp(V0.Max.Y, V1.Max.Y, Result.Max.Y)

		return (minXAlpha + minYAlpha + maxXAlpha + maxYAlpha) / 4
	end,

	-- Note: Region3, NumberSequence, and ColorSequence are complex types
	-- where inverse lerping is not straightforward. The implementations below
	-- provide approximations.

	Region3 = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Approximate by comparing center points
		local center0 = V0.CFrame.Position
		local center1 = V1.CFrame.Position
		local resultCenter = Result.CFrame.Position

		return InverseLerp(center0, center1, resultCenter)
	end,

	NumberSequence = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Approximate by comparing first keypoint values
		if #V0.Keypoints > 0 and #V1.Keypoints > 0 and #Result.Keypoints > 0 then
			local firstKeypoint0 = V0.Keypoints[1]
			local firstKeypoint1 = V1.Keypoints[1]
			local firstKeypointResult = Result.Keypoints[1]

			return InverseLerp(firstKeypoint0.Value, firstKeypoint1.Value, firstKeypointResult.Value)
		end
		return 0.5
	end,

	ColorSequence = function(V0, V1, Result)
		-- Approximate by comparing first keypoint colors
		if #V0.Keypoints > 0 and #V1.Keypoints > 0 and #Result.Keypoints > 0 then
			local firstKeypoint0 = V0.Keypoints[1].Value
			local firstKeypoint1 = V1.Keypoints[1].Value
			local firstKeypointResult = Result.Keypoints[1].Value

			return InverseLerp(firstKeypoint0.R, firstKeypoint1.R, firstKeypointResult.R)
		end
		
		return 0.5
	end,
}

function IsSameTypes(...)
	local LastType
	
	for _, Value in {...} do
		if not LastType then
			LastType = typeof(Value)
		else
			assert(LastType == typeof(Value), `[{script}] {debug.info(2, `n`)} same types expected, got {typeof(Value)}`)
		end
	end
	
	return LastType
end

function Module.GetLerp<Value1, Value2>(Value1: Value1, Value2: Value2): (Alpha: number)-> Value1 & Value2 
	local Type = IsSameTypes(Value1, Value2)
	assert(Lerp[Type], `[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} type {Type} not found`)
	return function(Alpha: number)
		return Lerp[Type](Value1, Value2, Alpha)
	end
end

function Module.Lerp<Value1, Value2>(Value1: Value1, Value2: Value2, Alpha: number): Value1 & Value2
	local Type = IsSameTypes(Value1, Value2)
	assert(Lerp[Type], `[{script}] {debug.info(1, `n`)} type {Type} not found`)
	return Lerp[Type](Value1, Value2, Alpha)
end

function Module.Alpha<Value1, Value2, Value3>(Value1: Value1, Value2: Value2, Value3: Value3): number
	local Type = IsSameTypes(Value1, Value2, Value3)
	return Alpha[Type](Value1, Value2, Value3)
end

return table.freeze(Module)

local Module = {}
local Promise = {}

export type PromiseStart = typeof(Module)
export type Promise = typeof(Promise)

local ErrorHandler = require(script:WaitForChild(`ErrorHandler`))
local EmptyTable = table.freeze{}

type([[ PromiseStart ]]) do
	do
		Module.PromiseStatuses = {
			Started = `Started`,
			Cancelled = `Cancelled`,
			Resolved = `Resolved`,
			Rejected = `Rejected`,
		}
	end
	
	--[[
		Create promise
	]]
	function Module.New(Function: (Promise: Promise)-> ()?): Promise
		Function = type(Function) == `function` and Function or tick
		local self = setmetatable({
			Traceback = debug.traceback(nil, 2),
			Status = Module.PromiseStatuses.Started,
			Success = false,
			Thread = nil, -- task.defer(Function, self)
			Result = nil, -- Тут хранится результат
			Function = Function,
			OnResult = {},
		}, Promise)
		
		self.Thread = task.defer(Module.NewPromiseThread, self)
		
		return self
	end
	
	--[[
		Create promise that wait until all promises is completed successuful
	]]
	function Module.All(Promises: {Promise}): Promise
		assert(type(Promise) == `table`, `[{script}] table expected, got: {typeof(Promises)}`)
		
		return Module.New(function(self)
			for _, Promise in Promises do
				local Success, Result = Promise:Await()
				if not Success then
					self:Reject(Result)
				end
			end
			
			self:Resolve()
		end)
	end
	
	--[[
		Check if its Promise
	]]
	function Module.Is(IsPromise: Promise?): boolean
		return getmetatable(IsPromise) == Promise
	end
	
	--[[
		Create a thread with promise function
	]]
	function Module.NewPromiseThread(Promise: Promise)
		--Excecuting function and catching error
		local Success, Result = xpcall(Promise.Function, Module.NewErrorHandler(Promise.Traceback), Promise)

		if not Success then
			Promise:Reject(Result)
		end
	end
	
	function Module.NewErrorHandler(Traceback: string)
			assert(type(Traceback) == `string`, `Traceback ~= string: {typeof(Traceback)}`)

			return function(ErrorObject: ErrorHandler.Error)
				--print(ErrorObject)
				-- If the error object is already a table, forward it directly.
				-- Should we extend the error here and add our own trace?

				--if type(ErrorObject) == "table" then return ErrorObject end

				return ErrorHandler.New({
					Error = ErrorObject,
					Kind = ErrorHandler.Kind.ExecutionError,
					Trace = debug.traceback(`{ErrorObject}`, 2),
					Context = `Promise created at:\n\n {Traceback}`,
				})
			end
		end
	
	table.freeze(Module)
end

type([[ Promise ]]) do
	
	do
		Promise.__index = Promise
		Promise.OnResult = nil :: {[any]: (...any)->()}
		Promise.Status = nil :: string
		Promise.Result = nil :: {any}
		Promise.Traceback = nil :: string
		Promise.Success = nil :: boolean
		Promise.Function = nil :: ()-> ()
		Promise.Thread = nil :: thread
		Promise.RetryHanler = nil :: ()-> ()
	end
	
	type([[ Public ]]) do
		--[[
			Wait for Promise to end
		]]
		function Promise.Await(self: Promise, Unpack: boolean?): (...any)
			if self.Status == Module.PromiseStatuses.Started then
				local ThisThread = coroutine.running()
				
				table.insert(self.OnResult, function(Status: string)
					task.defer(ThisThread)
				end)

				coroutine.yield()
			end
			
			return self.Success, Unpack and table.unpack((self.Result or EmptyTable)) or self.Result
		end
		
		--[[
			Excecute function on Success/Fail
		]]
		function Promise.AndThen(self: Promise, OnSuccess: (...any)-> ()?, OnFail: (Error: string)-> ()?)
			task.defer(function()
				local Success, Result = self:Await(false)
				--print(Result)
				if Success and OnSuccess then
					OnSuccess(table.unpack((Result or EmptyTable)) or Result)
				elseif not Success and OnFail then
					OnFail(table.unpack((Result or EmptyTable)) or Result)
				end
			end)

			return self
		end
		
		function Promise.Catch(self: Promise, Handler: (Error: string)-> ())
			return self:AndThen(nil, Handler)
		end
		
		function Promise.Resolve(self: Promise, ...)
			self.Result = ... and {...}
			self:_Finalize(Module.PromiseStatuses.Resolved)
		end
		
		function Promise.Reject(self: Promise, ErrorResult: string)
			self.Result = {ErrorResult}
			self:_Finalize(Module.PromiseStatuses.Rejected)
		end
		
		function Promise.Timeout(self: Promise, Time: number)
			local Traceback = debug.traceback(nil, 2)
			
			task.delay(Time, function()
				if not self.Success then
					self:Reject(ErrorHandler.New({
						Kind = ErrorHandler.Kind.TimedOut,
						Error = "Timed out",
						Context = string.format(
							"Timeout of %d seconds exceeded.\n:Timeout() called at:\n\n%s",
							Time,
							Traceback
						),
					}))
				end
			end)

			return self
		end
		
		function Promise.Retry(self: Promise, Times: number)
			
			local Tries = 0
			
			self.RetryHandler = function()
				if Tries >= Times then
					return true
				else
					Tries += 1
					return Module.NewPromiseThread(self)
				end
			end

			return self
		end
	end
	
	type([[ Private ]]) do
		function Promise._Finalize(self: Promise, Status: string)

			if self.Status == Module.PromiseStatuses.Rejected then
				if self.RetryHandler and not self.RetryHandler() then -- Перезапускаем всё заного
					return
				end
			end
			
			if self.Status == Module.PromiseStatuses.Started then
				if coroutine.running() ~= self.Thread then
					coroutine.close(self.Thread)
				end
				
				self.Status = Status
				self.Success = self.Status == Module.PromiseStatuses.Resolved
				
				local OnResult = self.OnResult
				for I, Function in OnResult do
					task.defer(Function, self.Status)
					OnResult[I] = nil
				end
			else
				warn(`[{script}] Trying to update Status on completed Promise \n\n {debug.traceback(nil, 2)}`)
			end
		end
	end	
end

return Module
